sanskrit: nirvāṇasūcakaguṇāṣṭakavarga pūrṇaṃ taṃ śaṃṅkaraṃ sakaladuḥkhaharaṃ namāmipūrvaṃ tu yattvayā proktaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kathayasva mevaśyādiyakṣiṇīmaṃtrasādhanāntaṃ samuddhṛtamkhananotpāṭanaṃ mantraiḥ kārayedvai cikitsakaḥśaraddhemāntike devi tvaco mūlaparigrahaḥvasante puṣpapatre ca grīṣme ca phalabījakemūle śuṣke balaṃ cārddhaṃ malādau bhiṣaje tathāvṛkṣādīnāṃ phalaṃ bījaṃ svakīye cārtave tathāniśāyāṃ vanajā vīryā jalajā balino divāmāraṇāntāni śaṃsanti ṣaṭkarmāṇi manīṣiṇaḥgrīṣme vidveṣaṇaṃ kuryātprāvṛṣi stambhanaṃ tathāhemante pauṣṭikaṃ kuryāduktakarmaviśāradaiḥarddharātre śaratkāle uṣā hemanta ucyateananyakaraṇātte hi dhruvaṃ siddhyanti nānyathātṛtīyāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ tathākarṣaṇakarma vaistambhanañca caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ pratipadyapidvādaśyāṃ māraṇañcaivamekādaśyāṃ tathaiva casarvavidyāprasiddhyarthaṃ tithayaḥ kathitāḥ kramātuccāṭanaṃ budhe bhaume vidveṣādi śubhaṃ bhavetvidveṣoccāṭanaṃ vahnivāyuyogena kārayetmāhendramaṇḍalāsthāśca proktāḥ karmaprasiddhidāḥpūrvāṣāḍhā ca tatkarmmasiddhidā śambhunā smṛtāḥpuṣya punarvasurvahnimaṇḍalasthāḥ prakīrtitāḥvāyumaṇḍalamadhyasthāstattatkarmaprasiddhidāḥśāntikaṃ pauṣṭikañcaiva hyabhicārika karmma ca

sanskrit: tatrāṅguṣṭhāsamārūḍhā sarvakarma hyubhe tathāvidhimantravihīnaṃ tu kāṣṭhavadbheṣajaṃ bhavetkāryaviddhirbhavettena vīryamasti ca tatra vaijātā vidhinā vihitā oṣadhayaḥ siddhidā na syuḥnyūnaṃ tathādhikaṃ vā dravyamadravyaṃ jagurbhiṣajaḥśrāddhairupāsitairvāpi saṃgrāhyaṃ sarvamauṣadhamādau vṛkṣasya mūlañca gatvā tamabhimaṃtrayetapasarpantu te sarve vṛkṣādasmācchivājñayābalamāyuśca me dehi pāpānme trāhi dūrataḥyena hīndro'tha varuṇo yena tvāmapacakramemā pātemāni patite mā te tejonyathā bhavetmama kārye kṛte siddhe tataḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyasikathitaṃ cātra yatnena mūlikāgrahaṇādikamoṅkāraśirasaṃ cāpi oṅkāraśirasaṃ tataḥnirāmiṣānnabhoktā ca japtavyo mantra eva caye me gotrasamutpannāḥ paśavo ye ca sarvataḥpṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā ca ye sādhyā gṛhītvā nāma tatra vaisiddhyanti sarvakāryāṇi nānyathā siddhibhāgbhavettataḥ kṣobhayate lokān darśanādeva sādhakaḥvibhūtyā saṃyutaṃ mantraṃ tilakaṃ lokavaśyakṛtpuṣye punarnavāmūlaṃ kare saptābhimantritam || baddhvā sarvatra pūjyaḥ syānmantrastavatraiva kathyate || aiṃ rauṃ ḍaṃ kṣobhaya bhagavati tvaṃ svāhā | mantrabhimamuktayogasya pūrvamayutadvayaṃ japettataḥlalāṭe tilakaṃ kuryādvaśī kuryājjagatrayamsnāne lepe ca taccūrṇaṃ yojyaṃ vaśyakaraṃ bhavetśirasā dhārettacca cūrṇaṃ sarvatra vaśyakṛtoṃ namo bhagavatimātaṅgeśvarī sarvamukharañjini sarveṣāṃ mahāmāye mātaṅgi kumārike lahalahajihve sarvalokavaśaṃkari svāhā || sahasraṃ japtvā uktayogānāṃ siddhiḥ

sanskrit: tanmūlaṃ rocanāyuktaṃ tilakena jagadvaśamtāmbūlena pradātavyaṃ sarvalokavaśaṃkaramsvarṇena veṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā tenaiva tilake kṛteimaṃ maṃtramuktayogena sahasraṃ japettataḥ siddhiḥtatpūgaṃ khādyate yena yāvajjīvaṃ vaśībhavetpriyo bhavati sarveṣāṃ dṛṣṭamātre na saṃśayaḥtāmbūle vā pradātavyaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamamoṃ piṅgalāyai namaḥ anena maṃtreṇābhimantryoktayogān sādhayetkṛṣṇapecikamāhṛtya tattailena pradīpakamtena netrāñjanaṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetmukhe niḥkṣipya sarveṣāṃ priyo bhavati nānyathāvaśyaṃ karoti sakalaṃ viśvāmitreṇa bhāṣitamanāmikāyā raktena tilakaṃ lokavaśyakṛtpiṣṭvā tu vaṭikāṃ kṛtvā tilakaṃ vaśyakṛtparamvaṭikāṃ kārayetprājñastilakena jagadvaśamtrailokyaṃ vaśatāṃ yāṃti dṛṣṭamātre na saṃśayaḥsaṃgrāhya dhārayedvaśyaṃ kurute sakalaṃ jagattenaivāñjitamātreṇa vaśīkuryājjagattrayampriyo bhavati sarveṣāṃ naraḥ kṛtvā lalāṭakenāsāgre tilakaṃ kṛtvā vaśīkuryyānna saṃśayaḥkṛtvā lalāṭaphalake tilakaṃ kṛtajño lokatrayaṃ vaśayati kṣaṇamātrakeṇayogo'yamevabhuvanāni vaśīkarotikurvanti vakratilakena vaśaṃ jagantikurvanti vaśyamakhilaṃ jagadapyakasmāttenāñjanena vaśatāṃ kila yāti lokaḥ

sanskrit: ekīkṛtyāñjayennetraṃ yaṃ paśyati vaśī bhavetmaṃtritaṃ dīyate yasmai vaśībhavati niścitamgavāṃ kṣīreṇa tilakaṃ rājavaśyakaraṃ dhruvamsaṃgṛhya bharaṇī-ṛkṣe puṣyarkṣe vā vidhānataḥkare sudarśanāmūlaṃ vaddhvā rājapriyo bhavetśākhāṃ caiva viśākhāyāṃ haste patraṃ tathaiva catilākāt strī vaśaṃ yāti yadi sākṣādarundhatīoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya cāmuṇḍe amukīṃ me vaśamānaya svāhā | uktayogānāmayameva maṃtraḥyasyā nāmnā pibettoyaṃ sā strī vaśyā bhaved dhruvamoṃ namaḥ kṣiprakāminī amukīṃ me vaśamānaya svāhāoṃ hūṃ svāhā | anenābhimantrya dadyātdīyate kusumaṃ yasyai sā vaśyā bhavati dhruvamtasmādimaṃ prayatnena sādhayemantramuttamamhaste baddhvā tu kurute vaśagāṃ varayoṣitamyasyāḥ śirogatamidaṃ vihitaṃ vicūrṇaṃ dāsī bhavejjhaṭiti sā taruṇī vicitramvāmaṃ vilimpati padaṃ sahasaiva yasyā vasyaiva sā bhavanti nātra vikalpabhāvaḥsā'nyaṃ na yāti puruṣaṃ manasāpi nūnaṃ dāsī bhavediti manoharadivyamūrttiḥliptvā dhvajaṃ pariramatyabalāṃ naro yāṃ tasyā sa eva hṛdaye mukuṭatvametitāmbūlādau pradātavyaṃ vaśyā bhavati niścitamyasyāḥ sā vaśatāṃ yāti bindumātreṇa tatkṣaṇāttaruṇyā hṛdaye dattaṃ tatkṣaṇātstrī vaśā bhavetprāṇānte'pi ca sā nārī taṃ naraṃ na vimuñcatiayuta dvayena siddhiḥjaṭāmāṃsīṃ samaṃ nimbaṃ cūrṇayenmaṃtravittamaḥsālaṅkārāṃ naraḥ kanyāṃ labhate māsamātrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛkṣe ca pūrvaphālgunyāṃ yastāṃ kanyāṃ prayacchatiyonilepātpatiṃ dāsaṃ karotyapi ca durbhagāukta yogānāṃ saptābhimaṃtrite siddhiḥsvaśoṇitaṃ rocanayā tilakaṃ pativaśyakṛtbhūrjapatraṃ ca madhunā yonilepe patirvaśaḥdātavyaṃ svāmine bhoktuṃ vaśyo bhavati nānyathāvātsyāyanena bahudhā pramadājanānāṃ saubhāgyakṛtyasamaye prakaṭīkṛto'sautasyāḥ patissapadi vindati dāsabhāvaṃ goṇīsutena kathitaḥ kila yogarājaḥiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne vaśīkaraṇaṃ nāma prathamopadeśaḥkṛtvā trividhahāṃ hāṃtaṃ tadantaṃ he dvitīyakamsahasrārddhasya jāpena phalaṃ bhavati śāśvatamsthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva ākṛṣṭāste varāṅganebhakṣyaṃ dravyaṃ svahastena kṛtvā maṃtravibhāvanamte sarve yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti tatkṣaṇātsaṃdhārya svakare maṃtrī tato mantramimaṃ japetoṃ hrīṃ rakṣa rakṣa cāmuṇḍe turu turu amukīmākarṣaya amukīmākarṣaya hrī asya maṃtrasya pūrvamevāyutaṃ japettataḥ siddhiḥ | oṃ cāmuṇḍe jvala jvala prajvala prajvala svāhā | amuṃ maṃtraṃ striyaṃ dṛṣṭvā japettatkṣaṇāt sā strī pṛṣṭhataḥ samāgacchati pūrvamayutaṃ japettatassiddhiḥpuruṣasya paśūnāṃ vā kṣipedākarṣaṇaṃ bhavetkṛkalāsasya raktena pratimāṃ kārayettataḥsādhyānāmākṣaraṃ tasyāstadraktaivilikheddhṛdiākarṣayettu tāṃ nārīṃ śatayojanasaṃsthitāmtāmbūlena samaṃ dadyātsvayamāyāti tatkṣaṇātbhinnau kṛtvā dahettau tu citākāṣṭhaistayoḥ punaḥtayorekāmajāśṛṅge dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā parīkṣayetaparaṃ rakṣayedvastre nocennāyāti kāminīoṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāya svāhā | imaṃ mantraṃ pūrvamekāyutaṃ japet | tataḥ uktayogamabhimantrya siddhiḥ

sanskrit: bhujadaṇḍa sthitaścārkassarvaśastranivāraṇamhaste kāṇḍaṃ bhayaṃ nāsti saṃgrāme ca kadācanavakrasthañcakarasthañca sarvāyudhanivāraṇamvārāhī vajriṇī cāndrī mahālakṣmīstathaiva casmṛtvā caiva kare baddhvā sarvaśastra nivāraṇīkhadirāṅgāramadhye tu praviṣṭo'sau na dahyateoṃ matkaṭiṃ tacchayaghaneśekaṭīya manīya śrī-alipyaprāyambudīye vaśanarakīrya mantrī krīṃ phaṭoṃ krīṃ mahiṣavāhinī jambhaya jambhaya mohaya mohaya bhedaya bhedaya agniṃ stambhaya stambhaya ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥdīptāṅgaraistato loharmantrayukterna dahyatemantrastu pūrvavatatra maṃtralekhanaṃ pūrvavatvāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu niḥkṣipedvandhayejjalamkṣaṇārddhena ghaṭaṃ bhidyājjalaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhatilepayeddhastapādau tu jalastambhanamuttamamgodhācarmamayaṃ baddhaṃ kṛtvārūḍho bhavejjaleghanamaṅgulamātraṃ tu śoṣayetpūrayejjalaiḥudakena sahāghṛṣṭaṃ lalāṭe tilake kṛtebhakṣayeddhārayedvastrairdivyastambhakaraṃ paramuttarābhimukhaṃ grāhyaṃ divyastambhakaraṃ mukhelalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā taptadivyajayī bhavetravitaṇḍulajairdivyaiḥ kṛtadoṣo vimucyatetaptalohaṃ lihetpaścātkṛtadoṣo vimucyateliptapāṇirnaraḥ satye taptadivye viśuddhyatigovājimeṣīmahiṣīḥ stambhayetkariṇīmapidarśanājjapataḥ stambhito bhavati kṣipram

sanskrit: tasyotthāne bhavetstambhaḥ siddhayoga udāhṛtaḥniśi kṛṣṇa caturdaśyāṃ tridine tatra jāgarettasyāḥ śākhā latā grāhyā śubha-ṛkṣe svamantrataḥkṣipedyasyāsane tāṃ taṃ stambhayettatkṣaṇād dhruvamtulyaṃ tulyaṃ vacāśvetādravyameṣāṃ samāharettilakaiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ buddhistambhakaro bhavettanmūlacūrṇa yonisthaṃ na garbhaṃ sambhavetkvacitna garbhaṃ dhārayetsā strī muktena labhate punaḥchāyāśuṣkaṃ sthitaṃ cāsye vīryastambhakaraṃ nṛṇāmnīlīmūlaṃ śmaśānasthaṃ kaṭyāṃ baddhvā tu vīryadhṛkliṅge tadā rametkāntāṃ svabhāvāddviguṇaṃ naraḥvarāṭākṣaṃ kṣipedvinduḥ sthiraḥ syācchirasā dhṛtambhaume prātaḥ samuddhṛtya kaṭyāṃ baddhvā tu vīryadhṛkvimuñcati vimuktena siddhiyoga udāhṛtaḥkṛkalāsasya pucchāgramudrikāpreta tantubhiḥveṣṭyā kaniṣṭhikā dhāryā naro vīryaṃ na muñcatibījacyutiṃ dhārayati prasaṅge khyātaḥ sadāyaṃ kila yogarājaḥjayedakāṇḍaṃ suratāvatāre pumān purandhrīḥ smaratīvravegāḥbhuktvā ramecca ramaṇīṃ tadā binduḥ sthiro bhavetkumārikākartitasūtrakeṇa baddhaṃ jayatyāśu manojabījamjihvopari sthite tasminnaro vīryaṃ na muñcatimadhvājyasahitāllepānnaro vīryaṃ na muñcatinīlotpalasitāmbhojakesaraṃ madhuśarkaramamībhirnābhilepena ciraṃ ramati kāmukaḥkṣaudreṇa piṣṭvā parilipya nābhiṃ stambhaṃ prapadyet puruṣasya bījam

sanskrit: hṛdaye pādayorvīryaṃ dravate na kadācanamadhunā padmabījasya tadvallepena vīryadhṛkbhāvayetsaptavāraṃ taṃ liṅgalepena vīryadhṛkliptvā liṅgaṃ naro vīryaṃ cirakālaṃ na muñcatimardayitvā lipelliṅgaṃ sthitvā yāmaṃ tathaiva cavīryastambhakaraṃ puṃsāṃ samyaṅnāgārjunoditampunarnavācūrṇavilepanācca jahāti bījaṃ na kadācidetatvilipya kāntājaghane ca kānte na labhyate śukramadhaḥ kadāpivīryadhṛkpādalepena taṭakāṇḍasya lepanātbheḍīkṣīreṇa taṃ piṣṭvā karṣaṃ bhuktvā tu vīryadhṛkbhakṣatyājyaṃ prayatnena śukrastambhanamuttamamyāvajjvalati dīpo'yaṃ tāvadvīryaṃ na muñcatiliṅgalepena cānena vīryastambhakaraṃ bhavetbaddhaṃ vindusthirakaraṃ mukte tu cyavate punaḥātmamūtreṇa tallipyaṃ liṅgamūlaṃ tu vīryyadhṛkmūlaṃ piṣṭvā tu liṅgāgre lepayeccandanaissahatathā karatale dadyādvāme binduḥ sthiro bhavetkṛtvāñjanaṃ ca tenāñjajyādarddharātraṃ sthiro bhavetravivāre samānīya cādattāramaṇīkṛtaiḥbinduḥ sthiratvamāpnoti mukte skhalati tatkṣaṇāthemahvālocanaṃ tulyaṃ kṛṣṇadhattūrabījakamkṣiptvā taddhārayedvakre vīryastambhakaraṃ bhavetiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne śatrumukhastambhanādivarṇanaṃ nāma caturthopadeśaḥprajñāvidhau sakalakarmaṇi kautuke vā dhūpaḥ sadaiva kṛtibhirviniyojanīyaḥyā dhūpayennijagṛhaṃ vasanaṃ śarīraṃ tasyāstu dāsa iva mohamupaiti lokaḥ

sanskrit: ebhistu tilakaṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ mohayennaraḥbhṛṅgarājena sājyena tilakaṃ mohayennaraḥtenaiva tilakaṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ mohayennaraḥoṃkāraṃ śirasi kṛtvā hūṃ ante phaḍiti nyasetmukhe sādhyasya niḥkṣipte mohamāyāti tatkṣaṇātoṃ bhīṃ kṣāṃ bhīṃ mohaya mohaya || oṃ namo bhagavatīpādapaṃkajaparāgebhyaḥ || asya maṃtrasya vāratrayajapānmohamāpnuvanti janāḥtruṭibījaṃ samaṃ piṣṭvā tāmbūlādau prayojayetbhoktuṃ deyaṃ svahastena mohamāpnoti ceśvaraḥvṛścikodbhavacūrṇena dhūpo mohayate nṛṇāmniśāyāṃ kurute mohaṃ dhūpo guggulusaṃyutaḥtathā dhūpaḥ samaṃ bhāgaṃ mohayatyeva niścitamharitālaṃ samaṃ dhūpo mohayet sakalānnarāmgorocanasamāyoge tilakaṃ śatrumohanamtatkṣaṇānmohamāpnoti conmatto jāyate naraḥsamākṣikaiḥ sitāmbhojeḥ svasthaḥ pānādbhavennaraḥtasmādahaṃ gandhavidhānamādau vilāsinaḥ sarvamudīrayāmieṣo'ṅganāyāḥ kathitaḥ kavīndraiḥ śarīradaurgandhyaharaḥ pralepaḥkakṣādidaurgandhyamapi prabhūtaṃ vināśayatyāśu nidāghakālestrīpuṃsayorgharmajagātragandhaṃ vināśayatyāśu vilepanenakadambapatraṃ lodhraṃ ca arjunasya tu puṣpakampiṣṭvā gātrodvartanācca durgandha ca vināśanamliptvā śarīraṃ pramadā tu tena ciraprasūtaṃ vinihanti gandhamvilipya gātraṃ taruṇī nidhāghe durgandhagharmāmbucayaṃ nihantigrīṣme narāṇāṃ na kadāpi dehe gharmmacyutiḥ syāditi bhojarājaḥajamūtratakrapiṣṭairudvartitamaṅgamanupamaṃ bhavati

sanskrit: tadardhabhāgaḥ kathito nakhasya syādeṣa gandho madanaprakāśaḥsasaurabho'yaṃ surarājayogyaḥ khyātaḥ sa gandho naramohanākhyaḥlepaḥ priyo'yaṃ suramānavānāmudīritaḥ pūrvakavīndradhīraiḥetāni gātreṣu vilāsinīnāṃ śrīkhaṇḍa tulyaṃ prakaroti gandhamsthito mukhānte puruṣasya rātrau karoti puṃsāṃ mukhavāsamiṣṭamtāmbūlagarbhā divase ca rātrau karoti puṃsāṃ mukhavāsamiṣṭamapyarddhamāsena mukhasya gandhaḥ karpuratulyo bhavati prakāmammāsaikamātreṇa mukhaṃ tadīyaṃ gandhāyate ketakagandhatulyamvadanasya durāmodaṃ nihanti pariśīlitāśītatoyaṃ palārddhaṃ tu āsyadurgandhanāśanamtathākṛte bhavedāsye durāmodavināśanamsarvaṃ piṣṭvā vaṭīṃ kuryānmukhadurgandhanāśanamdurgandhaṃ hanti no citraṃ kṣaudrairvā kuṣṭhacūrṇakamstrīpuṃsayoryauvanayorhaṭhena vināśamāyāti mukhasthagandhaḥnaśyanti gaṇḍāḥ piṭakāḥ prarūḍhā māsārddhamātreṇa vilāsinīnāmgaṇḍapradehāḥ piṭakāstryaheṇa prayānti nāśaṃ puruṣasya tanvyāḥmukhodbhavā yauvanajā narāṇāṃ naśyanti nūnaṃ piṭakāḥ krameṇasaptāhamātreṇa mukhasthanīlīṃ nihanti kṛṣṇāmiti rantidevaḥnighnanti nīliṃ trayavāramātrāccandreṇa tulyaṃ vadanaṃ bhaveccataruṇyāḥ piṭakāḥ sarvā naśyanti mukhasambhavāḥetā liptāstryahaṃ yāvadbhavetpadmopamaṃ mukhammukhakāntikaro lepaḥ piṭakātilakālajitvaṭāṅkuramasūrāśca vyaṅgaghnā mukhakāntidāḥkarṣapramāṇairetaistu tailasya kuḍavaṃ pacetajāpayastaddviguṇaṃ śanairmudvagninā pacet

sanskrit: mukhaprasanne'pi hitaṃ nīlakarkaśavarjitamatra dviruktatvādyaṣṭīmadhukarṣadvayaṃ tathāvāripiṣṭo hito lepo vadane śyāmikāṃ haretkṛte lepe nihaṃtyāśu śyāmikāṃ vadanāśritāmpeṣyaṃ gairikasaṃyuktamajākṣīreṇa pācitamvacā lodhramuśīraṃ ca sarpissarjarasaḥ payaḥlepo'yaṃ mukhapādābhyāṃ padmavatkurute bhṛśamsaptarātraprayogeṇa puṇḍarīkadalaprabhamyasmādato mūrddhajarāgasevāṃ kuryādyathaivāñjanabhūṣaṇānāmkākatuṇḍīphalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cūrṇayitvā prayatnataḥvarṣārddhaṃ tiṣṭhate kṛṣṇabhramarāñjanasannibhamtriphalālohacūrṇaṃ tu nīlī bhṛṅgīsamūlakamtenaiva mardayecchīrṣe rañjate bhramaropamamtulyāṃśaṃ bhāvayeccūrṇaṃ dinaikaṃ bhṛṅgajadravaiḥtenābhyaṅgādghanāḥ keśā rañjanaṃ bhramaropamamajākṣīreṇa taṃ piṣṭvā lepanātkeśarañjanamtallepādrañjayetkeśaścaturmāsaṃ sthiro bhavettridinaṃ lepayecchīrṣaṃ dvimāsaṃ keśarañjanambhṛṅgarājarasaprasthaṃ tailaṃ kṛṣṇatilātsamamtallepaṃ tridinaṃ kuryyātkeśarañjanakaṃ bhavetnāgapuṣpaṃ dine madhye tallepātkeśarañjanamtattailaṃ grāhayedyantre tannyasyetkeśarañjanamagninā mṛdunā pācyaṃ taṃ nyasyetkeśarañjanamsaptāhaṃ rañjayetkeśān sarvanyasye tvayaṃ vidhiḥdvayostulyena tailena pacenmṛdvagninā kṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snigdhaṃ bhāṇḍagataṃ bhūmau sthitaṃ māsātsamuddharetnirvāte kṣīrabhojī syātkṣālayetriphalājalaiḥyāvajjīvaṃ na sandehaḥ keśāḥ syurbhramaropamāḥmahākālasya bījāni vākucībījatatsamamjapāpuṣpadravairevaṃ tataḥ pātālayantrakeveṣṭayetkṣīrabhojī syādvātātapavivarjitaḥkṛṣṇavarṇāḥ prajāyante tathā bhavati pratyahamtaddrutaṃ jāyate kṛṣṇaṃ karṣaikaṃ śirasi kṣipetkapālarañjanaṃ khyātaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥkrameṇa śaṃkhopamamāśu kṛṣṇaṃ śiroruhaṃ mecakatāmupaitiprasthapramāṇaṃ ca tilasya tailaṃ pacedamobhirviditopadeśaḥpākastadaivāsya narairvidheyaḥ khyātaṃ pṛthivyāmapi nīlatailampuṣpaṃ na śreyāṃsi samānayuktaṃ ciraṃbhavedṛṣṭa iti prayogaḥamībhirālipya punaḥ sukeśān karoti śuklānapi kṛṣṇavarṇānakālajātaṃ palitaṃ saraukṣyaṃ keśasya kāruṣyamalaṃ nihantiharītakyāśca kvāthena āmalakyāssamaṃ tataḥkeśamūlaṃ samālepya meghatulyo bhavetkacaḥsaurabhyakāntī kila mūrddhajānāṃ snātvā naro vindati sarvadaivasnātvā naraḥ saurabhamarddhamāsaṃ vaikalpamāpnoti śiroruhasyamāṃsīyutānāṃ parilepanena snātvā naraḥ saurabhakāntimetiabhyaṅgayogena śiroruhāṇāṃ yūkādilikṣāpracayaṃ nihantipāradaṃ mardayenniṣkaṃ kṛṣṇadhattūrajairdravaiḥyūkāḥ patanti niśśeṣaṃ mastakānnātra saṃśayaḥdviniśānavanītena lepānmauleḥ prakaṇḍunutdhātrīphalaṃ samaṃ piṣṭvā lepo yūkāvināśaka
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāradena samaṃ mardya lepo yūkāvināśakaḥviḍaṅgena samaṃ lepāddhūmo yūkānivārakaḥbilvamūlaṃ sagomūtraṃ lepādyūkāvināśanamanena yogena sadaiva keśā rohanti kṛṣṇāḥ kuṭilā viśālāḥlipyedanenaiva mahendraluptaṃ keśāḥ prarohantyapi hastamadhyeindraluptaṃ nihantyāśu kiṃvā jambīrajadravaiḥpiṣṭvā lepātprajāyante keśāḥ karataleṣvapilepo'yaṃ saptarātreṇa dṛḍhakeśakaraḥ paraḥtallepena dṛḍhāḥ keśāḥ kuṭilāḥ saralā apiyāvatsutaptatāṃ yāti tāvallepamimaṃ kurumadhunā saha lepena vāyukṣīroṭakapraṇutpiṣṭaṃ taṇḍulatoyena lepo'yaṃ taṃ vināśayetjapāpuṣpaiśca taṃ hanyātkṛṣṇāgomūtralepanātsaptāhamātreṇa śiraḥ pralepādbhavanti dīrghāḥ pracurāśca keśāḥtridinaṃ bhakṣayettacca keśavardhanamuttamamtattailaliptāḥ keśāśca śuklāḥ syurnnātra saṃśayaḥbhāvayettasya lepena śuklatāṃ yānti mūrddhajāḥtaccūrṇaṃ saha tailena lepācchuklā bhavanti hiiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne mohanādivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamopadeśaḥato balārthaṃ ratilampaṭasya vājīvidhānaṃ prathamaṃ vidadhyesaptarātraṃ tu gokṣīrairvṛddho'pi taruṇāyatemadhvājyasaṃmiśritameva līḍhvā daśa striyo gacchati nirviśaṅkaḥsakṣaudramāleḍhi niśāmukhe yo nūnaṃ sa vṛddhastaruṇatvametikṣīrānupānādramate tu tāvadyāvannarāṇāmudarasthametatjaṭharakuharamadhye yāti pākaṃ na yāvadramayati kṛśadehopyaṅganānāṃ samaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etatprayogātsaptāhājjāyate retaso'mbuddhiḥsarpiṣā payasā pītvā ratau caṭakavadbhavetkṣīreṇa saṃsādhya ca bhakṣayitvā sa yāti nārīśatamugraretāḥhavyena siddhaṃ saha saindhavena mahābalaḥ syādupayujyamānaḥudumbarasamaṃ khādedvṛddho'pi taruṇāyatesādhitau bhakṣayedyastu sa gacchetpramadāśatamyaḥ khādetsa naro gacchetstrīnāṃ śatamapūrvavatcūrṇamidaṃ payasā niśi peyaṃ yasya gṛhe pramadāśatamastisa pītvā śarkarākṣaudraṃ kaliṅga iva hṛṣyateśarkarāpippalīkṣaudrayuktaṃ tadvṛṣya mucyatevārāhyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍūcyāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥtilānāṃ nistuṣāṇāṃ tu prasthaṃ dadyātsucūrṇitammākṣikaṃ śarkarārddhena mākṣikārddhena vai ghṛtametadekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇa snigdhabhāṇḍe nidhāpayetmāsaikamupayogena jarāṃ hanti rujāmapihantyaṣṭādaśakuṣṭhāni tathāṣṭārbudarāṇi cakṣaye caiva mahāvyādhiṃ paṃcakāsān sudāruṇānviṃśatisūkṣmarogāṃśca saṃsṛṣṭānsānnipātikānsarvānarśogadānhanyādvṛkṣamindrāśaniryathāstrīṇāṃ śataṃ gacchati sātirekaṃ prahṛṣṭapuṣṭaṃ ca yathā vihaṅgamnārasiṃhamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvarogaharaṃ nṛṇāmtrikaṭu triphalā kuṣṭhaṃbhṛṅgī saiṃdhavadhānyakamajamodā yavānī ca yaṣṭī madhukameva cacyavantyetāni cūrṇāni tāvadeva tadauṣadhamtāvadeva sitā deyā yāvadāyāti bandhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthāpayedghṛtabhāṇḍe tu śrīmanmadanamodakampravṛddhamagniṃ kurute mandamagniṃ pradīpayetkṛśānāmatirūkṣāṇāṃ snehanaṃ sthaulyakāraṇamsarvarogaharaṃ hyetatsaṃgrahagrahaṇīharametasya satatābhyāsād vṛddho'pi taruṇāyateyena lakṣairvarastrīṇāmaraṃsta yadunandanaḥmuśalī kadalīkandadravaiśca mardayeddinampuṭaṃ deyaṃ punarmardyamevamaṣṭapuṭaiḥ pacetgodugdhaṃ markaṭībījaiḥ palārddhaṃ pācayedanusarvāṅgodvarttanaṃ kuryātsvarasaiḥ śālmalīrasaiḥmarditaṃ vālukāyantre yāmaṃ saṃpuṭagaṃ pacetyatheṣṭaṃ bhakṣayeccānnaṃ kāmayetkāminīśatammṛtahemnastu karṣaikaṃ palaikaṃ ca mṛtābhrakamrudrairgajapuṭaiḥ pacyāddinaikānte samuddharetanaṅgasundarīṃ khādedramedvāmāśatatrayampalaikaṃ sitayā cānnaṃ bhakṣayetkāmayecchatamnikṣipya kadalīkande punarlepyaṃ ca gomayaiḥevaṃ saptapuṭaiḥ pacyātkandaiḥ kandaṃ pṛthakpṛthakdolāyaṃtre ca saṃyuktaṃ chāgīdugdhe punaḥ pacetgajapippalikā lājā kadalyā kokilākṣakaiḥuddhṛtya cūrṇayetsvacchaṃ bhakṣayed guñjācatuṣṭayamkāminīnāṃ sahasraikaṃ kṣobhayennimiṣāntarekokilākṣasya bījāni phalaṃ guṇaśatāvarīpalārddhamanupānaṃ syātkiṃcitpeyaṃ gavāṃ payaḥyāmamekaṃ punargandhaṃ pūrvādarddhaṃ vinikṣipet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvadrāvairdinaikaṃ tu kācakupyā nirudhya capañcaguñjāsitāsārddhaṃ raso'yaṃ madanodayaḥgavāṃ kṣīreṇa tatpeyaḥ palārddhamanupānakammūlaṃ gokṣuramāsābhyāṃ śuṣkacūrṇaṃ prakalpayetkarṣamekaṃ gavāṃ kṣīraiḥ peyaṃ kāmāṅganāyakambhojanānte pibetkṣīraṃ rāmāḥ kāmayate śatamvidārī muśalīkandaṃ kokilākṣasya bījakamgavāṃ kṣīraiḥ pibetkarṣaṃ ramayet kāminīśatamyogaḥ kāmāmṛtaḥ khyāto balāyurvīryavarddhakaḥdhātrīphalasya cūrṇaṃ tu bhāvayettatphaladravaiḥcūrṇapādaṃ mṛtaṃ lohaṃ madhvājye śarkarānvitamkāmayetstrīśataṃ nityaṃ dhātrīlohaprabhāvataḥnārikelodakairbhāvyaṃ yāmāntaṃ peṣayetsamamtadvattairvaṭikā kāryā madhvājyābhyāṃ tu bhakṣayetsatāmbūlaṃ śatāmūlamanupānaṃ nirantaramtena nābhipralepena bandhaḥ sadyo vimuñcatitena liṅgapralepena ramedrāmāśataṃ naraḥyaṣṭī nāgabalā kacūramadanaṃ jātīphalaṃ saindhavamccūrṇaṃsaṃvijayāsitādviguṇitā madhvājyayoḥ piṃḍitamkṣīṇe puṣṭikaraṃ gadakṣayakaraṃ hantyāśu sarvāmayamdhatte sarvaguṇaṃ haṭhātsvavadaśādhyānapradhānaṃ punaḥsiddho'yaṃ samadṛṣṭapratyayakarī rājñā sadā sevyatāmnaro vīryakarānyogānsamyak śuddho nirāmayaḥna pūrvaṃ ṣoḍaśādvarṣātsaptatyāḥ parato na cakalpenādagdhavayaso vājīkaraṇasevitaḥ

sanskrit: sthiropacitamāṃsāśca bhavanti strīṣu saṃyutāḥsarvartuṣu ca grīṣmeṣu pakṣātpakṣādvrajed budhaḥkāntāsaṃgāddivāpi hyasakṛdapi naro dhātu baiṣamyametiakālamaraṇaṃ caiva bhajataḥ striyamanyathāativyavāyājjāyante rogāśca kṣayakādayaḥjarāyāściṃtayā śukraṃ vyādhibhiḥ karmakarṣaṇātnārīṇāmavasannatvādabhighātādasevanātyā vaśyā śikṣitā yā ca sā strī bṛṣyatamā matākṣīṇānāmalpaśukrāṇāṃ strī kṣīṇāśca ye narāḥbahupatnīvatāṃ nṛṇāṃ yogā vājikarā hitāḥiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne vājīkaraṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhopadeśaḥno bhakṣayediti samastajanaprasiddhaḥtasmānnarairbheṣajato vidheyā gāḍhī kriyā manmathamandirasyaanena liptaṃ madanātapatraṃ prayāti saṃkocamalaṃ yuvatyāḥliptvā varāṅgaṃ madhukena tulyaṃ vṛddhāpi kanyeva bhavet purandhrīhaṭhena gāḍhaṃ labhate tadaṅgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ naraireṣa haṭhena yogaḥyasyā varāṅge nihitā kṣaṇena kanyātvametyāha sa mūladevaḥnavaprasūtāpi haṭhena nārī kanyā bhavet saṃyamato na citramlepena nāryāḥ smarasadmarandhraṃ saṃkocayatyāśu haṭhena yogaḥnigadati yogaṃ rantidevo narendraḥkiñcitpallavayāmi nīrajadṛśāṃ prītyā paraṃ kāmināmpralipya tāsāṃ puruṣaprasaṅgātprāgeva vīryacyutimātanotidrutā bhavetsā sahasaiva nārī dṛṣṭaḥ sadāyaṃ kila yogarājaḥamībhirālipya punaḥ suliṅgaṃ bījaṃ karotyāśu nitambinīnāmśataṃ naro yaḥ savilāsinīnāṃ retaḥ prapātaṃ kurute haṭhena

sanskrit: liṃgasya lepanāttena strīṇāṃ drāvaṇamuttamamtatkṣaṇāddravate nārī padmapatre yathā payaḥetairliṅgapralepena dravennārī na saṃśayaḥliptvā dhvajaṃ yo ramate'ṅganānāṃ sa śukramākarṣati śīghramevalepena liṃgasya karoti retaścyutiṃ vipakṣapramadājanasyaprabhavati vanitānāṃ kāmakallola mānaḥliṃgalepena rāmāṇāṃ drāvo bhavati saṃgamemadhu rocanayā sārddhaṃ liṅgalepe dravanti tāḥupahārapaśo raktaṃ gṛhṇīyādantarikṣataḥārvartya sammukhaṃ strīṇāṃ dṛṣṭamātre dravanti tāḥkṣiptvā baddhvā striyai dadyādghrāṇamātre dravanti tāḥāharedvāmajaṅghāṃ tu ṭiṭṭibhasya tu dakṣiṇaḥkarṇopari sthitaṃ tena dṛṣṭvā strī dravati dhruvamhastena strīkarasparśe dravatyagnau ghṛtaṃ yathāsamucitaratirāgāṃ saṃvidadhyādavaśyamjapedaṣṭottaraśataṃ tatra yogasya siddhayedrāvaya drāvaya strīṇāṃ madaṃ pātaya pātaya svāhā ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ || itituraṅgaśatrornavanītayogāllepena liṅgaṃ musalatvametitadāsthūlaṃ bhavelliṅgaṃ niścitaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥtailena vṛddhiṃ khalu yāti liṅgaṃ varāṅganālokamanoharaṃ tatsthūlaṃ mahattaraturaṅgamatulyamāśu śephaḥ karotyabhimataṃ na hi saṃśayo'stiaśvagandhā tilaṃ kṣaudraṃ saindhavaṃ śvetasarṣapāḥmāsamātraṃ sadā liptvā mardayecca divāniśamsthūlaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca dīrghaṃ ca māsālliṅgaṃ prajāyatetilaṃ tailena saṃpakvaṃ tallepaḥ sthūlaliṅgakṛt

sanskrit: stanaliṅgakarṇapāṇivarddhanaṃ bhakṣaṇāditaḥmadhunā saha lepena liṅgaṃ syānmusalopamammahiṣīnavanītaṃ ca muśalīcūrṇamiśritamtena pralepayelliṅgaṃ māsaikād varddhate dhruvammāraṇotthaṃ kṛmi caiva kaṇṭakārīphalaṃ jalaiḥtadvacca muśalī sājyā lepālliṃgasya dārḍhyakṛttaile paktvā pralepena liṅgaṃsthaulyakaraṃ dhruvamanena mardayelliṅgaṃ varddhate musalopamamsitāyuktaṃ jalaiḥ piṣṭvā māsaikaṃ lepayettadāadbhutaṃ varddhayelliṅgaṃ yonikarṇastanāni capiṣṭvā dhvajaṃ limpati tasya kāmaṃ bhavedayodaṇḍamiva kṣaṇenalepena liṅgaṃ sahasaiva puṃsāṃ lohopamaṃ syāditi dṛṣṭametatkṛṣṇasūtraiḥ kaṭiṃ baddhvā ūrdhvaliṅgaṃ karoti caanena maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā māsaikaṃ lepayettataḥhayāripatnīnavanītayogātkurvanti pīnaṃ kucakumbhayugmamnārīkucau cārutarau ca pīnau kuryādasau yogavaraḥ pradiṣṭaḥlepena vakṣojayuge ca śīghraṃ vṛddhi prayātaḥ patite ramaṇyākathita iti puraivaṃ cakradattena yogaḥarddhaśeṣaṃ haretkvāthaṃ kvāthārddhaṃ tilatailakampatitaṃ yauvanaṃ strīṇāṃ māsāduttiṣṭhate dhruvamtoye caturguṇe pācyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ samāharetsnehaśeṣaṃ pacettailaṃ nasyena māsamātrataḥbālāstrīvṛddhanārīṇāṃ yauvanaṃ kurute'dbhutamsaṃmarddayedūrdhvagahastakena tadā stanaṃ syātpatitaṃ navaṃ vaitattailaṃ tilake nāpi stanasyopari dāpayet

sanskrit: vṛddhāyāḥ kanyakāyā vā hyabalāyāḥ payodharaupiṣṭvā stanayuge deyaṃ bhavetpīnapayodharāgajapippalikāyuktaṃ sadyobhinnajalena canayatte tu kadācidvai tāmratālaphalaṃ tathāsamānaṃ jalabhāgaṃ ca dattvā pākaṃ samācaretdivāpralepanādeva lohatvaṃ jāyate'cirātdhūpena yoniṃ niśi dhūpayitvā nārī pramodaṃ vidadhāti bhartuḥtyajecca ratyāścirakālabhūtaṃ gandhaṃ varāṅgasya na saṃśayo'trakandarpagehaṃ mṛgalocanānāṃ romāṇi rohanti kadāpi naivasavastarorbhasmana eva pañca proktāśca bhāgāḥ kadalījalārdrāḥromāṇi sarvāṇi vilāsinīnāṃ punarna rohaṃti kadācidevanalena yuktāni vilepanena romāṇi nirmūlayati kṣaṇenasamabhāgapralepena romakhaṇḍanamuttamamtena liptvā kacā gharme sthite gacchanti tatkṣaṇāttena liptvā sthite gharme romakhaṇḍanamuttamamna niryānti punarlepātrisaptāhe kṛte satikusumbhatailataptānāṃ saptavāraṃ tathā guṇamprātastaptodakaiḥ śaṣpāḥ patantyāmūlatotthitāḥchāyāśuṣkaṃ ca taccūrṇaṃ pañcāhaṃ lepayetsadāpūrvavatkhaṇḍakeśānāṃ na punaḥ rohaṇaṃ bhavetlepānāddhanti keśāṃśca kaṭutailairmanaśśilāiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne gāḍhīkaraṇādilomapātanaṃ nāma saptamopadeśaḥnikhanyājjāyate ṣaṇḍha uddhṛte tu punaḥ sukhīkhānapānaprayogeṇa ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ jāyate nṛṇāmśītalaṃ madhunā yuktaṃ pibet ṣaṇḍhatvaśāntaye

sanskrit: yāvajjīvaṃ na sandehaḥ ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥdhattūrapuṣpabhakṣyeṇa punaḥ saṃpadyate sukhamekāntakaṃ tatkurute'nyapatnyā nottiṣṭhate tāmapahāya patnīmprayāti bhūyaḥ prakṛtaṃ tadaṅgaṃ dṛṣṭo naraireṣa sadā prayogaḥbhaktaṃ nipītaṃ kurute nikāmaṃ narasya ṣaṇḍhatvamiti prasiddhamsayāvakaṃ śarkarayānvitaṃ ca pītvā haret ṣaṇḍhakatāmavāpyatadbhakṣaṇādbhavetsadyo liṅgotthānaṃ na saṃśayaḥsampūjya vividhairdravyairnimantrya niśi saṃyataḥghṛtena peṣitaṃ kṛtvā saindhavena sadā ruciḥayomayaṃ bhavelliṅgaṃ kodravānnaṃ vivarjayetlepayedbhagabandhaḥ syāttakraiḥ prakṣālyamucyatesandhyāyāṃ bandhayettena poṭalī bhagabandhanīmayākṛtaṃ bhagabandhaṃ nāsti loke cikitsakāḥsarve vai vimukhaṃ yānti varjayetkāmukaistathāyantramantrāditantreṇa yatkiñcicchatruṇā kṛtamtasya śatrukṛto doṣaḥ śatrugehe bhaviṣyatitasyaiva liṃgasya varapraveśaṃ syāttatra nānyasya kadācidevabhavedvarāṅgaṃ prakṛtaṃ yuvatyā ityāha karttā haramekhalāyāḥliptvā dhvajaṃ tena ramettato yāṃ tasyāvināśaḥ puruṣāntareṇapunaḥ samāsādayati pradṛṣṭaṃ nārī tadaṅgaṃ khalu pūrvarūpamtasyāstadaṅgaṃ punareva bhūyātpūrvānurūpaṃ na hi saṃśayostigṛhakodārakaṃ na syādyāvaddhaste bandhanamgṛhāmbunā pītamidaṃ yuvatyāḥ karoti puṣpaṃ smaramandirasyaindravāruṇikāmūlaṃ yonisthaṃ puṣpabandhanutrajasvalā bhavennārī mūladevena bhāṣitam

sanskrit: puṣparodhe raktagulme strīṇāṃ sadyaḥ praśasyatekvāthaṃ raktabhave gulme naṣṭapuṣpe ca yojayettadbhakṣayitvā vanitā pranaṣṭaṃ puṣpaṃ labheta svabalānurūpamdravate tatkṣaṇādeva śukrapuṣpaṃ sravatyapicāturmāsyo bhaved garbhaḥ sravate tatkṣaṇādapipibedgarbhavatī nārī garbhaṃ sravati tatkṣaṇātgarbhaṃ nivārayatyeva raṇḍāveśyādiyoṣitāmtridinaṃ tena garbhasya sambhavo naiva jāyateyā nārī garbhasambhūtiḥ punastasyā na jāyatepuṣpaṃ na sā prasūtiṃ ca dhatte no garbhasaṃbhavaḥgodugdhe so'pi bhoktāraṃ mahāgarbhaṃ nivārayetkarṣaṃ bhuktvā pātayati garbhaṃ raṇḍākulodbhavāatyantaraktotthitamugravegaṃ nivārayet setunivāmbupūramkandarpagehe mṛgalocanāyā raktaṃ nihantyāśu haṭhena yogaḥpāyayetkarṣamātraṃ tadatiraktapraśāntayeguḍūcikā taṇḍulavāripītā strīṇāmanekaṃ rudhiraṃ jayeccayuktyā piṣṭvākṣamātraṃ tu pāyayettandulāmbunāghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ māṣayūṣabhojanaṃ śvetacandanamśarkarāmadhusaṃyuktamasṛksrāvavināśanampīto jayatyatibalaṃ pradaraṃ saśūlaṃ pītaṃ vitāruṇavilohitanīlakṛṣṇampeṭārikāyāḥ patraṃ ca māṣacūrṇena saṃyutamtasya bhakṣaṇamātreṇa hyatiraktanivāraṇamtasya bhakṣaṇamātreṇa raktādivikṛtiṃ haretbhakṣaṇādeva tadraktaṃ strīṇāṃ śamayati dhruvamcatvāriṃśatpalānyevaṃ vastrapūtaṃ prayatnataḥ

sanskrit: jīvantikolamandārā atasī kṣīrakākulīdrākṣāpāraśukoyaṣṭijīrakaṃ pratikārṣikamghṛtaśeṣaṃ samuttārya śīte jāte ca nikṣipetsitādaśapalaṃ yojyamidaṃ śatāvarīghṛtamkāmalāṃ vātarogāṃśca aśmarīṃ ca śirograhamtāsāṃ putrodayārthāya śambhunā sūcitaṃ purāekavarṇagavāṃ kṣīre kanyā hastena peṣayetkṣīraśālyamudgaṃ ca laghvāhāraṃ pradāpayetudvegaṃ bhayaśokaṃ ca divānidrāṃ vivarjjayetpatisaṅgādgarbhalābho nātra kāryā vicāraṇāekameva tu rudrākṣaṃ sarpākṣīkarṣamātrakammahāgaṇeśamantreṇa rakṣāṃ tasyānubandhayetoṃ dadanmahāgaṇapate rakṣāmṛtaṃ matsutaṃ dehipathyamuktaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ tadvatsaptadināvadhidevadālīyamūlaṃ tu grāhayetpuṣyabhāskarevandhyā ca labhate putraṃ deyaṃ pathyaṃ yathāpurākarṣaṃ pītvā labhed garbhaṃ pūrvavatkramayogataḥpathyamuktaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ tadvatsaptadinaṃ pibetsamūlāṃ sahadevīṃ ca saṃgṛhya puṣyabhāskarepūrvavatpibate nārī vandhyā bhavati gurviṇīkṣīrānnacaryā niyamena bhuṅkte putraṃ prasūte vanitā na citramvandhyāpi putraṃ labhate haṭhena yogastu so'yaṃ munibhiḥ pradiṣṭaḥprāpnoti garbhaṃ niyamaṃ carantī vandhyā ca nūnaṃ puruṣaprasaṅgātapyekavarṇāpayasā nipītaṃ striyaḥ smṛtaṃ putrakaraṃ munīndraiḥkandamūlaṃ ghṛtaiḥ piṣṭvā ṛtau sā garbhiṇī bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣīrodanaṃ prāśya patiprasaṅgād garbhaṃvidadhyāttaruṇī na citramṛtusnātā tridhā yā tu vandhyā garbhadharā bhavettadṛtau labhate garbhaṃ sā nārī patisaṃgatāputrajīvakapatraikaṃ pibetkṣīrair-ṛtau ca yātasya mūlaṃ caikavarṇākṣīraiḥ pītvā ca putriṇīnāryekavarṇāpayasā pītvā garbhavatī ṛtaugokṣīraiḥ pānamātreṇa vandhyā putravatī bhavetjanayati sutamekaṃ niścitaṃ puṣpitaivaetāni samabhāgāni hyajākṣīreṇa peṣayetṛtau nipīyamāne tu garbho bhavati niścitamtrirātraṃ saptarātraṃ vā vandhyā bhavati putriṇīṛtau nipīyamāne tu garbho bhavati niścitamhaste baddhvā labhetputraṃ sundaraṃ kulavarddhanamṛtusnāte tu pītaṃ syādapi vandhyā labhetsutambhāvitaṃ vaṭavandākaṃ pītaṃ vandhyā sutaṃ labhetkākavandhyā tu sā jñeyā cikitsāsyāstu kathyatemahiṣīnavanītena ṛtukāle tu bhakṣayetgarbhaṃ sā labhate nārī kākavandhyā suśobhanamaśvagandhīyamūlaṃ tu grāhayetpuṣyabhāskaresaptāhāllabhate garbhaṃ kākavandhyā cirāyuṣamtatra yogaḥ prakarttavyo yathā śaṅkarabhāṣitammārgaśīrṣe'thavā jyeṣṭhe pūrṇāyāṃ lepite gṛheśākhāphalasamāyuktaṃ navaratnasamanvitamtanmadhye pūjayeddevīmekāntīṃ nāma viśrutāmarcayedbhaktibhāvena madyamāṃsaiḥ samatsyakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī ṣaṭsu patreṣu mātaraḥdadhibhaktaiśca piṇḍāni saptasaṃkhyāni kārayetbilvābhaṃ saptamaṃ piṇḍaṃ śucisthāne bahiḥkṣipetkanyakā yoginī vāmā bhojayetsakuṭumbakaiḥvisṛjya devatāṃ cātha nadyāṃtatkalaśodakamviparīte punaḥ kāryaṃ yāvattāvatsusiddhidamprativarṣamidaṃ kuryyārddīrghajīvīsutaṃ labhetṛtukāle tu saptāhaṃ dīrghajīvī suto bhavetṛto tu pītvā supatiṃ prayāti dīrghāyuṣaṃ sā tanayaṃ prasūteajamodā haridredve hiṃguḥ kaṭukarohiṇīeteṣāṃ kārṣikairbhāgairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayetsarpiretannaraḥ pītvā nityaṃ strīṣu vṛṣāyateyā caivāsthiragarbhā syādyā nārī janayenmṛtamyonidoṣe rajodoṣe garbhasrāve ca śasyatenāmnā phalaghṛtaṃ hyetadrahasyaṃ parikīrtitamaraṇyagomayenātra vahnerjvālā pradīyatepalamātraṃ pibennārī tryahādgarbhaḥ sthiro bhavetsaṃpiṣya kṣīrakākolī pibetkṣīraistu gobhavaiḥgokṣīraistu dvitīye ca pītvā śāmyanti vedanāḥmañjiṣṭhāsahitāṃ piṣṭvā pibetkṣīraiścaturguṇaiḥpibecchītodakaiḥ piṣṭaṃ tṛtīye vedanāvatīathavā kṣīrakākolīṃ balāṃ piṣṭvā payaḥ pibetturyamāse gavāṃ kṣīraiḥ pibecchāmyati vedanāanantāṃ peṣayitvā tu gavyakṣīraiśca saṃpibetgokṣuraṃ pañcame māse garbhakleśaharaṃ pibet

sanskrit: goghṛtaṃ kṣīrasaṃyuktaṃ pibetpiṣṭvā ca pañcameṣaṣṭhe māsi gavāṃ kṣīraiḥ pibetkleśanivṛttayebalāyuktaṃ pibetpiṣṭvā godugdhaiḥ ṣaṣṭhamāsakepiṣṭvā ca saptame māsi kṣīraiḥ pītvā praśāmyatimṛṇālaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ kṣīraiḥ peyaṃ tu saptamenīlotpalaṃ gavāṃ kṣīraiḥ pibedaṣṭamamāsakeikṣupaṭolayomūlamebhiḥ kṣīraṃ prasādhayettatkṣīramambhasā pītvā garbhe śāmyati vedanāvedanā navame māsi śāntimāpnoti nānyathāebhiḥ siddhaṃ pibetks.īraṃ navame vedanāvatīpāyayeddaśame māsi gavāṃ kṣīraiḥ praśāntayeathavā madhukaṃ dāru śuṇṭhikṣīreṇa saṃpibetsaptāhamātraṃ viniyojya nārī stabhnāti garbha calitaṃ na citramgarbhaṃ kṣarantaṃ pratihanti śīghraṃ yogo'yamuktaḥ kila mūladevaiḥgarbhacyuti śūlamayīṃ nivārya karoti garbhaṃ prakṛtaṃ haṭhenasiddhaṃ payaḥśarkarayā vimiśraṃ saṃsthāpayed garbhamudasya śūlamśūlaṃ sarvavidhaṃ nihanti niyamādevaṃ ca yattatsmṛtamdadyādgarbhe pracalite pradare kukṣirujyapigurutaradoṣaiścalitaṃ garbhaṃ saṃsthāpayedāśudravamāṇeṣu garbheṣu garbhesthāpanamuttamamsamāṃśaṃ gavyadugdhena gurviṇī tatpraśāntayekṣaṇātprasūyate nārī garbheṇātiprapīḍitākaṭyāṃ baddhvāvimuktaṃ ca garbhaputraṃ tu tatkṣaṇātkaṭyāṃ baddhvā saptasūtraiḥ sukhaṃ nārī prasūyateyoniṃ vā lepayettena sā sukhena prasūyate

sanskrit: sahadevyāśvamūlaṃ vā kaṭisthaṃ prasavetsukhamnārī praveśayedyonau tatkṣaṇātsā prasūyatenābhiṃ ca lepayettena tatkṣaṇātsūyate dhruvampibedvā toyapiṣṭaṃ ca sā sukhena prasūyatekaṭītale mūrddhani nīlasūtraiḥ śīghraṃ prasūtiṃ kurute'ṅganāyāḥalambuṣāmūlamatho nibaddhaṃ yogadvayaṃ bhūpatirityavādītvyathāvihīnaṃ prasavaṃ haṭhena prāpnoti naivātra vikalpabuddhiḥśūlāturā pibennārī sā sukhena prasūyatetoyābhipānāt khalu garbhavatyā prasūyate śīghrataraṃ sukhenaoṃkāraṃ śirasaṃ kṛtvā ante namastrimūrtayesukhaṃ prasavamāpnoti sā putraṃ labhate dhruvammārjārasya malaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vaṃśatvagajamūtrakaiḥaikāhiko dvyāhikaśca jvaro naśyati tatkṣaṇātdhūpo bālagrahe deyo bālānāṃ grahaśāntayevaṃśatvak śikhipicchaṃ ca kaṃgunā ca samaṃ ghṛtamoṃ drutaṃ muñca muñca uḍḍāmareśvara ājñāpayati svāhā ||garbhiṇyā bālānāṃ satataṃ rakṣākaraḥ kathitaḥdvāre baddhaṃ tu bālānāṃ sarvagrahanivāraṇambālānāṃ kaṇṭhadeśe ca ḍākinībhayanāśanamnasyaṃ kuryyātpalāyante ḍākinīdānavādayaḥdhūpaḥ sarvajvaraghno'yaṃ kumārāṇāṃ jvarāpahaḥchucchundarī malaṃ māṃsaṃ haridrābilvapatrakamnihanti rodanaṃ rātrau bālasyāśu na saṃśayaḥravivāre raudraśuṣkamañjanātsarvabhūtahṛtḍākinīgrahabhūtāni tamaḥ sūryyodaye yathā

sanskrit: śuci paktvā tu saptāhaṃ matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāphalamśanau vā kujavāre vā bāladoṣopaśāntayebaddhaṃ gale ca jaghane bālo'hituṇḍikāṃ jayetpuṣyārke vā ravervāre bālo'hituṇḍikāṃ jayetbṛhatkūṣmāṇḍavṛttaṃ vā tenāhituṃḍikāṃ jayetājyena māsārddhanidaṃ pibanti rakṣā bhavenniścitameva puṣpeṛtvantakāle tridinaṃ purandhrī rakṣā bhavedāmaraṇāntamevasnānāvasāne niyamena pītvā rakṣāmavaśyaṃ kurute haṭhenajīvāntikaṃ niścitameva tasyā vandhyātvamuktaṃ kavipuṅgavenaṛtau nipītaṃ mṛgaśāvakākṣyā rakṣārthametanniyataṃ pradiṣṭamjyeṣṭhānakṣatre nimbavandākaṃ yasyā aṅge dīyate sā durbhagā bhavatisthāpayedyadgṛhadvāre tasya vai kalaho bhavetārdrāyāṃ yatra gṛhe tatra vai jāyate vairamyasya gṛhe sthāpayettasya nityaṃ kalaho bhavatijātīpuṣparasaiḥ piṣṭvā saptarātraṃ punaḥ punaḥyathāgotraṃ samāghrāti pitā putraiḥ samaṃ kaliḥiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne ṣaṇḍhīkaraṇādi kalahakaraṇāntaṃ nāmāṣṭamopadeśaḥkādidviravasānaṃ ca hyakṣaraṃ svarasaṃyutamoṃkāra śirasaṃ kṛtvā japtavyaṃ siddhimicchatāaśeṣāriṣṭanāśaḥ syādityāha purasūdanaḥadhorephasamāyuktamoṃkāraśirasaṃ tathāsarvathā tasya puṃsaḥ syātsarvāriṣṭavināśanamabhimantrya śatenāpi dadyāddevyai sadānaghena gṛhe'niṣṭapātaḥ syāllikhitvā sthāpane'pi caadhorephasamāyuktamoṅkāraśirasaṃ tathā

sanskrit: mamaiva hṛdayaṃ tasya sadā tadgatamānasaḥtrailokye tatsamo nāsti nityaṃ phalamavāpnuyātjñātibhiḥ sajjanaiścāpi śatrubhiśca viśeṣataḥantadvayaṃ samāgṛhyamadhorephasamanvitamoṃkārasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā rekhābindusamāyutamte sarve kṣemamāyānti satataṃ tasya jāpanātbāhubhyāṃ vyādhayo na syustvariṣṭāni viśeṣataḥtaddhūpena palāyante pretādyā dūrato dhruvamsaṃgṛhya śirasi kṣipte hyabhayaṃ bhavati dhruvamḍākinīgrahabhūtāni tamaḥ sūryodaye yathābhairavīṃ tu mahāpūrvīṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥsarve praharikā yānti nidrāyā vaśameva catasmin vāṭikāyāmāyāti tasyānena mantreṇa nidrāṃ karotimūlaṃ vā kākamācyāśca kṛṣṇāyāstadguṇaṃ smṛtamkarañjamūlaṃ śirasi baṃdhanātkurute tathāpiṣṭvā tadrañjayeccakṣurnidrāmāpnotyasaṃśayamlepayeddakṣiṇe pṛṣṭhe tasya nidrākṣayo bhavetsamanāgeśvaraṃ piṣṭvā nidrāṃ muñcati cāñjanātyasya netre'ñjanaṃ dadyānnidrā tasya vinaśyatietāni piṣṭvā kapaṭaveṣena khādayennidrābhañjanaṃ bhavatibandhanānmucyate tena śikhābaddho na saṃśayaḥplakṣāṃśena kakārāntaṃ likhed bandhanamocanamsparśanaṃ bandhavicchedaṃ kurute śīghra mārutaḥtanmalairguṭikāsparśāttālayantraṃ bhinatyalamsūkṣmacūrṇaṃ tu tāṃ kṛtvā lohakiṭṭamathāpi vā

sanskrit: taccūrṇaṃ loḍitaṃ kṛtvā mahālohaṃ bhinattyalamoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya uḍḍāmareśvarāya bahurūpāya nānārūpadharāya hasa hasa nṛtya nṛtya tuda tuda nānākautukendrajāladarśakāya ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā | anena sarvayogābhimantraṇāt siddhirbhavatiāya āya ciñciṭhi ciṭhi hāṃlā vajranandikā kālikā || anena maṃtreṇa śvetasarṣapaṃ śvetodumbarapuṣpaṃ triḥpaṭhitvā prathamadvāre kṣipet sarvadvārāṇi bhañjantitāmāghrāya gṛhādyānti makṣikā nātra saṃśayaḥarkapatreṣu vinyastaṃ mūṣakāntakaraṃ gṛhetaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca gṛhaṃ tyaktvā palāyante hi kautukamtamāghrāya gṛhaṃ tyaktvā sadyo niryānti mūṣikāḥchāgalīmūtrataḥ piṣṭvā pūrvavanmūṣikaṃ lipetmakṣikāmūṣakānāṃ ca jāyate tuṇḍabandhanammūṣakākarṣako dīpaḥ sāvarīguḍatailajaḥpūrve brahmā me baddhaḥ paścime viṣṇurme baddhaḥ uttare rudro me baddhaḥ dakṣiṇe yamo me baddhaḥ pātāle vāsukī me baddhaḥ phaṇisahasre baddhaḥ hrūṃ aṅguṣṭhāya namaḥ | karasampuṭaṃ kṛtvā tālatrayaṃ dadyāt | tato mūṣikamaśakanivāraṇaṃ bhavatitaddīpadarśanādeva kṣipraṃ naśyanti matkuṇāḥdīpaṃ tatkaṭutailena niśśeṣā yānti matkuṇāḥśvetāparājitāmūlaṃ bhallātakaviḍaṅgakamsarpāśca matkuṇā mūṣā gandhādyāṃti diśo daśalākṣāraso'rkapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpo vṛścikasarpahṛtcūrṇaṃ bhānuphalopetaṃ dahetsarjarasaiḥ samampalāyante gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yathā yuddheṣu kātarāḥetairdhūpo racitaḥ kīṭabhujagamaśakamakṣikādiharaḥlākṣāsarjjarasośīraṃ sarṣapaḥ patrakaṃ paramkṛtvā dīpaṃ prakurvīta matkuṇañca vinaśyatijambulo maśakaṃ hanti dhūpādvā gṛhamadhyataḥvālukāśvetasiddhārthān prakṣipet kṣetramadhyataḥmaśakāstatra no yānti mantravidyāprabhāvataḥnamonagaranāthāya hayaharaharaśila hayaharaharaśila sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tuṇḍabandhanaṃ kuru kuru hruṃ phaṭ svāhā | ujjayanīnagarī bhairavabole mahādevabhaṇḍāraphūlabole hanumantasākṣī asti-astu | anena mantreṇa saptābhimaṃtritaṃ candanaṃ bāṭikāmadhye niḥkṣipet | puṣpaphalaṃ samastaṃ nirupadravaṃ bhavati

sanskrit: kṣetramadhye tu nikṣipya sarvapakṣibhayaṃ haretśasyamadhye kṣipettena śasyavṛddhirbhaveddhruvamoṃ huṃkāriṇīprasava oṃ śītalam anena saptavāraṃ tṛṇādikamabhimantrya bhoktuṃ dadyāt tadā bahulaṃ dugdhaṃ prasavatiiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne ariṣṭanāśādiśasyopadravanāśanaṃ gomahiṣyādidugdhavardhanaṃ nāma navamopadeśaḥoṃ lohitamukhe svāhā asya aṣṭottarasahasrajapena puraścaraṇamoṃ dahadaha halahala svāhāoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya daṃṣṭrākarālāya amukaṃ saputrabāndhavaiḥ saha hana hana daha daha paca paca śīghraṃ uccāṭaya uccāṭaya huṃ phaṭ svāhā ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥoṃ hrīṃ daṇḍin daṇḍin mahādaṇḍinnamo'stu te ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥoṃ hrīṃ daṇḍin daṇḍin mahādaṇḍin namo'stu te ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya amukaṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa paca paca trāsaya trāsaya troṭaya troṭaya nāśaya nāśaya paśupatirājñāpayati ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya amukaṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa paca paca trāsaya trāsaya troṭaya troṭaya nāśaya nāśaya paśupatirājñāpayati ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥuddhṛte sati śāntirbhavatinikhanettu bhavettasya sadyaḥ uccāṭanaṃ dhruvamuccāṭanaṃ bhavettasya hyuddhṛte tu punaḥ sukhīcitāgnau bhasmataḥ śatrordattaṃ śirasi sundarīuccāṭanaṃ bhavettasya uddhṛte ca punaḥ sukhītaṃ yasya nikhaned gehe tasyaivoccāṭanaṃ bhavetoṃ kākatuṇḍidhavalāmukhi devi amukamuccāṭaya amukamuccāṭaya huṃ phaṭ svāhāpūrvoktamanunā tasya homayedvidhipūrvakamuccāṭanaṃ bhavettasya saputrapaśubāndhavaiḥkṛśāṅgīmasthimālāṃ ca kartrikāṃ ca tathāmbujāmeṣa yogavidhiḥ khyāto vīratantre maheśvarīdhūpairatīva vidviṣṭau snigdhāvapi bhaviṣyataḥsnigdhayorāśu vidveṣaḥ syādumeśānayorapimantrayitvā militvāgraṃ kṛṣṇasūtreṇa bandhayet

sanskrit: vidveṣo jāyate tatra mahākautukamadbhutamoṃ namo mahābhairavāya ca śmaśānavāsinyai amukāmukayorvidveṣaṃ kuru kuru krūṃ phaṭraktāśvamārapuṣpaikaṃ mantrayuktaṃ jalāñjalimparasparaṃ bhaveddveṣaḥ siddhayoga udāhṛtaḥoṃ amukaṃ hana hana svāhā anena mantreṇa kaṭutailāktaṃ trikaṭuṃ juhuyāttadā śatrurbadhiro bhavatikṣipedgātre bhavetkuṣṭhaṃ sitākṣīraṃ pibetsukhītagaraṃ peṣayettoyairlepāllūtādināśanamoṃ cāmuṇḍe hana hana daha daha paca paca matha matha calha calha amukaṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā anena kaṭutailenāktanimbapatrāṇi yasya nāmnā hūyante tasya śīghraṃ jvaro bhavati | citrakapuṣpasahasraṃ hunet cāturthikajvaro bhavati | lavaṇamaṣṭādhikasahasraṃ hunet dāhajvaro bhavatioṃ cāmuṇḍe hana hana daha daha paca paca amukaṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā anena mantreṇa nimbapatrakaṭutailaṃ sādhyanāma gṛhītvā juhuyāt sa jvareṇa gṛhyate | anena lavaṇāhutīraṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt sa śūlena gṛhyateoṃ namaḥ śrīnṛsiṃhāya devāya danujāraye namaḥ kṛṣṇāyaoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya uḍḍāmareśvarāya amukaṃ rogeṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa paca paca tāḍaya tāḍaya kledaya kledaya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ uktayogānāmayaṃ mantraḥpañcāṅgulaṃ riporgehe vahnimāndyaṃ prajāyatebandhakyā udaraṃ nyastaṃ sarvamaṃtaḥ puṭe pacetkhāne pāne'rpayedyasya tasya cakṣuḥ praṇaśyatidṛṣṭiṃ stambhayituṃ tasya maricākṣaphalaṃ vacāakṣirogo bhavatimṛtpātrasthaṃ saptavastramakṣakāṣṭhena cālayetsthāpayeddirghayātrā syāttasyāpi na hi saṃśayaḥriporgehe soma-ṛkṣe dīrghayātrā ca tasya vaidattvonmatto bhavecchatruḥ sitākṣīraiḥ punaḥ sukhīsurāmāṃsasitākṣīraṃ bhakṣaṇācca sukhāvahamdattaṃ yasyāñjanaṃ netre unmatto'sau prajāyateajākṣīreṇa saṃyojyaṃ pānenonmattanāśanamtanmūrdhni dattaṃ kurute piśācavannivarttate muṇḍitamastakenaphalasyānte pradātavyamunmatto bhakṣaṇād bhavet

sanskrit: oṃ namaḥ unmattakāriṇī vidye ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ | uktayogānāmayameva mantraḥnikhanedyasya gehe tu bhavettasya kulakṣayaḥhuṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā saptābhimantritaṃ śatrugehe nikhanet kulakṣayaṃ yātinikhanetsaptadhā japtaṃ mārayedripusantatimjāyante sphoṭakāstīvrā daśāhānmaraṇaṃ bhavetsnānabhūmūtra bhūmṛtsnāṃ sarpavakre viniḥkṣipetnikhanenmriyate śatrussamutthāne sukhī bhavetśarāgre phalakaṃ kuryāddhanuṣaścitrakendhanaiḥtadvajjātena bāṇena mriyate tatkṣaṇādripuḥnikhanenmriyate śatruruddhṛte ca punaḥ sukhīśatrorgehe sthāpayitvā ripornāśo bhaviṣyatividdhaḥ syāttatkṣaṇādeva proñchite ca śubhaṃ bhavetkṛṣṇachāgāśvapādasya khurasthaṃ romakaṃ haretsarvaṃ dagdhvā tu bhāṇḍāntastadbhasma jalasaṃyutamyaṃ śiro namyate tasya vedho bhavati niścitammayūrapucchanīlābjaṃ piṣṭvā lepaiḥ sukhāvahamripuviṣṭhāṃ vṛścikaṃ ca khanitvā bhuvi niḥkṣipetmriyate malarodhena uddhṛte ca punaḥ sukhīoṃ hrīṃ kṣaḥ amukaṃ kṣam | anena mantreṇa rājikālavaṇaśivanirmālyāni kaṭutailena sahasrahomāt śatrorvadhaḥtakreṇa kṣālayeccakṣuḥ sustho bhavati ghoṭakaḥsusthaścandanapānena nasyaṃ prāpya na saṃśayaḥnikhanedaśvaśālāyāṃ mārayatyeva ghoṭākānaṣṭāṃgulaṃ tu nikhanedaśvaśālā vinaśyatiśatābhimantritaṃ kṣetre sasyaṃ tatra vinaśyatikṣetramadhye tadā śatroḥ śasyaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati

sanskrit: kadalīvāṭikāmadhye nāśayetkadalī phalamśatābhimantritaṃ tena tasya vastrāṇi nāśayetaṣṭāṃgulaṃ ca nikhanennāśayeddhīvare gṛhesaptāṃgulaṃ maghā-ṛkṣe bhallātaṃ kāṣṭhakīlakamśatrorvāpīhradādau ca matsyastatra vinaśyatinikhanetkumbhakārasya śālāyāṃ bhāṇḍanāśakṛtpañcāṃgulaṃ nimbakīlaṃ tadṛkṣe pūrvavatphalampākasthāne tu bhāṇḍānāṃ kṣiptaṃ sphoṭayate dhruvamkṛtvā bhāṇḍārasphuṭaṃtyeva muktānāṃ mantra ucyatenikhanettailaśālāyāṃ tailaṃ tatra vinaśyatiaṣṭāṃgulaṃ tadā tatra grāhako nahi gacchatiaṣṭāṃgulaṃ gopagehe godugdhaṃ ca vinaśyatitadā tasya ca tāmbūlaṃ nāśamāyāti niścitamnaśyanti sarvaśākāni śeṣāṇyalpabalāni cadvādaśāṃgulamānaṃ tu sūtraṃ tatra vinaśyatiśauṇḍikasya ca gehe ca madirā tatra naśyatikarmakāragṛhe kṣiptaṃ lohaṃ taptaṃ bhavennahiatra pārīśasambhramaṇakāya vedhacchedakajñānavijñāna nā phūṭai | amukārakāyaṃ hūṃkalikā- caṇḍītu-imāremaśilapātharapaḍe amukāragāme nārasasamārai putrīmārauṃ tāraka-ulaṭāvedhe virūpākṣarivānī ulaṭāvedhe pitra pānī je mora piḍe kare ghā-ulaṭāvedhe tākakatātujī khā phoṭaphokaṭaṇḍīvirūpākṣera ājñā vāratrayaṃ paṭhitvā pratiprātaḥ trigaṇḍūṣajalaṃ peyam yadi kenāpi viddhaṃ syāt śarīraṃ tadaiva tena kāryamitiiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne uccāṭanādi karmakāralauhanāśanaṃ nāma daśamopadeśaḥtadviṣṭhāliptahastasya dravyaṃ lupyati tatkṣaṇātaṅkolibījacūrṇaṃ tu yojyaṃ peṣyaṃ punaḥ punaḥathavā kāṃsyapātre dve tena kalkena lepayettayoradhaḥ kāṃsyapātre patitaṃ tailamāharetsaphalo jāyate vṛkṣastatkṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥnyastaṃ jale mahāścaryastatkṣaṇātpadmasambhavaḥ

sanskrit: śigru pratipalaṃ cūrṇaṃ dvātriṃśatipalaṃ ghṛtamghṛtaśeṣaṃ samuttāryya lihed vāgbuddhidāyakamcūrṇayitvā dravairbhāvyaṃ maṇḍūkībrāhmisambhavaiḥghṛtaśeṣaṃ samuttārya lihedvāgbuddhidāyakamajājī cājamodā ca yaṣṭīmadhukasaṃyutambhakṣayenmāsamekaṃ tu bṛhaspatisamo bhavetmadhunā bhakṣayetkarṣaṃ spaṣṭavāgjāyate dhruvamapāmārgasya pañcāṅgaṃ kṣaudreṇa pūrvavatphalamghṛtena bhakṣayetkarṣaṃ nityaṃ granthasahasradhṛkaśvagandhājamodā ca pāṭhā kuṣṭhaṃ kaṭutrayametadarddhaṃ vacā caiva cūrṇitaṃ madhusarpiṣāsahasragranthadhārī syānmūko'pi vākpatirbhavetnirvāte madhusevī syādbrahmacārī kavirbhavetcūrṇitāṃ saghṛtāṃ bhuktvā saptāhe vākpatirbhavetjaptvāyutaṃ ca siddhiḥ syātpaścāttaireva bhakṣayetghṛtena lehayenniṣkaṃ vākśuddhismṛtibuddhikṛtbhojyaṃ kṣīreṇa śālyannaṃ saptāhe vākpatirbhavetsaptāhakramayogena lehyaṃ syātpūrvavatphalamchāyāśuṣkaṃ ca taccūrṇaṃ mantreṇaivābhimaṃtritamtakreṇa sarpiṣā vāpi jīrṇānte kṣīrabhojanamevaṃ saptāhamātreṇa kavirbhavati bālakaḥmadhunā sahitaṃ cūrṇaṃ peṣayitvā śilātalejāyate susvaraḥ puṃsāṃ kinnaraiḥ saha gīyategomūtreṇa pibetkarṣaṃ kinnaraiḥ saha gīyatepalaṃ lehyaṃ bhavennādaḥ kinnarādhika eva ca

sanskrit: vacā saindhavaśigrūtthaṃ mūlaṃ peṣyaṃ samaṃ samamkaṇṭhaśuddhirbhavettasya kinnaraiḥ saha gīyatekokilasvara eva syādguṭikābhuktimātrataḥvacā cūrṇaṃ samāṃśena palaikaṃ vāriṇā pibetgandharvasadṛśaṃ gānaṃ kokilānāṃ svaro yathākaṇṭhaśuddhirbhavettasya kinnaraiḥ saha gīyategomūtreṇa pibet karṣa kinnaraiḥ saha gīyatekhādetsamāsataścakṣurgṛdhradṛṣṭisamaṃ bhavetañjane cakṣurogāśca na bhavanti kadācanabhṛṅgīdravairyutaṃ vāpi timiraṃ paṭalaṃ haretañjayannavanītena hanti puṣpaṃ cirantanamajāmūtreṇa bhūdhātrībhūlaṃ piṣṭvā ca vartikāañjanānnāśayetpuṣpaṃ kṣaudrairvā svarṇamākṣikamśoṇitaṃ carmakopaṃ ca māṃsavṛddhiṃ ca nāśayetkṛṣṇājasya ca māṃsāntaḥ pippalīṃ maricaṃ kṣipetmadhyājyastanyasaṃpiṣṭaṃ rātryandhaharamañjanamcirabilvarasairghṛṣṭaṃ rātryandhaharamañjanamrātryandhakaṃ kāñjikayā nihanti punarnavā netrapunarnavaṅkarīvibhītakasya majjā ca śaṃkhanābhirmanaśśilānāśayettimiraṃ kaṇḍūṃ paṭalānyarbudāni caadhikāni ca māṃsāni yaśca rātrau na paśyatichāyāśuṣkā vaṭī kāryā nāmnā candrodayā vaṭīsamyucyate netragatairvikārairbhṛtyairyathā kṣīṇadhano manuṣyaḥapaharati karṇanādaṃ bādhiryaṃ cāpi pūraṇātetatkalkaṃ pradāyaiva bādhirye paramauṣadham

sanskrit: kaduṣṇapūraṇātkarṇe niśśeṣakṛmināśanaḥtannālīpūrite karṇe dhruvaṃ gomakṣikāñjayettatra sthitāstu kṛmayo nāśamāyānti niścitambhakṣayetkarṣamātraṃ tu badhiratvapraśāntayelaśunāmalakaṃ tālaṃ piṣṭvā taile caturguṇetattailaṃ nikṣipetkarṇe bādhiryaṃ ca vināśayetchāgī kṣīraiḥ pralepo'yaṃ karṇapālī vivarddhayetsaptāhādutthite lepyaṃ karṇapālī vivarddhateguñjāmūlakṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ mahiṣīkṣīrasaṃyutamkarṇayorlepayennityaṃ varddhayennātra saṃśayaḥmahiṣīnavanītena lepātkarṇo vivarddhatecarmacaṭakasya raktena lepātkarṇo vivarddhatecaladantā dṛḍhāyante pratyahaṃ dantadhāvanātpiṣṭvā ca guṭikā kāryā dantairdhāryā kṛmīn haretkāśīśaṃ ghṛtasaṃpakvaṃ dhāryaṃ dante vyathāpahamtaddhūmaspṛṣṭadantānāṃ kīṭapāto bhavantyalamsthirāḥ syuścalitā dantāstatkāṣṭhairdantadhāvanātjambīraphalamadhyasthaṃ vastrairbaddhvātryahaṃ pacetbhāvitaṃ bhānudugdhena tālakaṃ sūkṣmapeṣitamgharṣaṇāccalitān dantāṃstatkṣaṇātkurute dṛḍhāntadgarbharasahomotthāṃ piḍikāṃ tārasaṃyutāmjambīraphalamadhyasthāṃ dolāyantre tryahaṃ pacetdantarogān haretsarvān gharṣaṇāccalitā dṛḍhāḥmukhe ca dhārayeddhīmān dantadārḍhyaṃ karaṃ paramdṛḍhāḥ syuścalitā dantāḥ saptāhānnātra saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: navanītena dīpāḥ syuḥ kajjalaṃ nṛkapālataḥmantrayitvāñjayennetre devairapi na dṛśyateetanmantrāyutajapātsiddhirbhavati || uktādṛśyaprayogāṇāmayameva maṃtraḥ | anena mantreṇāṣṭottaraśatābhimantritāṅgulitaila prayogātsiddhā bhavantiadṛśyakāriṇī sā tu mukhasthā nātra saṃśayaḥguṭikā mukhamadhyasthā sā'dṛśyakariṇī matākākārinakhacañcvāpi samabhāgaṃ vicūrṇayetadṛśyo bhavati kṣipre sarvakāryaprasādhakaḥkākanetraṃ ca maricaṃ piṣṭvā kāryaṃ ca mūtrakaiḥtenaivāñjitanetrastu adṛśyo bhavati dhruvamnaktamālasya tailena tatra śvetārkasūtrajāmtenāñjanena manujastvadṛśyo bhavati dhruvamsukṛṣṇaṃ caiva mārjāraṃ mārayitvā catuṣpathetatsaṃgṛhya prayatnena kṣālayecchītavāriṇāpūjayitvā mahākālīṃ gorocanasamanvitamtadvartitilakādeva naro'dṛśyo bhaved dhruvamtrilohaveṣṭitā sā tu mukhasthā'dṛśyakāriṇītatphalaṃ vadanasthaṃ hi sākṣādadṛśyakārakamsā vaṭī mukhamadhyasthā adṛśyaṃ kurute dhruvammukhasthaṃ kurute'dṛśyaṃ yathecchaṃ vicarenmahīmmukhe prakṣipya ca naro'dṛśyaḥ syānnahi saṃśayaḥgṛhītvā pānapātreṇa adṛśyo jāyate naraḥbharaṇyāṃ tu samāgṛhya vandāṃ kārpāsasambhavāmpibeduttaraṣāḍhāyāmaśokavṛkṣasambhavāmvandākaṃ vā kare dhṛtvā adṛśyo jāyate naraḥliṅgamaṅkolavṛkṣādhaḥ sthāpayitvā prapūjayet

sanskrit: vṛkṣaṃ liṅgaṃ ghaṭaṃ caiva sūtrenaikena veṣṭayetevaṃ dvidvidinaṃ kuryādaghoreṇa samarcayetphalāni pakvānyādāya pūrvoktaṃ pūrayed ghaṭamtuṣavarjjaṃ tataḥ kuryādbījānāṃ ghaṭṭayenmukhamvistīrṇamukhabhāgāntaḥ kumbhakārakarodbhavāmkuṃḍalyākārayogena yatnādūrdhvamukhāni vaiātape dhārayettailaṃ grāhayettaṃ ca rakṣayetnasyaṃ deyaṃ mṛtasyaiva kāladaṣṭasya tatkṣaṇātnasyaṃ deyaṃ mṛtasyaikaṃ kāladaṣṭasya vā kṣaṇātjīvamāyāti nocitraṃ mahādevena bhāṣitamkarṣamuṣṇajalaiḥ pīto mṛte mṛtyuharo bhavetiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne nidhidarśanāñjanādi mṛtyusañjīvanī kathanaṃ nāma trayopadeśaḥkṛtrimaṃ yogajaṃ caiva vṛścikādyaṃ tu sambhavamnāma vakṣye viṣāṇāṃ tu śambhunā kīrtitaṃ purākrūraṃ śaṭhaṃ karmaṭhaṃ ca haridraṃ kālakūṭakamśṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī ca meṣaśṛṅgī halāhalamsaṃkocaṃ madhupākaṃ ca rohiṇaṃ meduraṃ tathāetanmadhye hyatikrūraṃ saṃkocaṃ kālakūṭakameṣāṃ dehapraviṣṭānāṃ śṛṇu lakṣaṇamucyatekāsaśvāsau tīvradāho lakṣayed gadgadasvarambhojane cāñjane pāne lepe sarvaviṣāpahamniṣkamātraṃ na sandehaḥ kāladaṣṭo'pi jīvatinaramūtreṇa saṃpītvā ekaikaṃ tu viṣaṃ haretgirikaṇyāśca vā mūlaṃ naramūtreṇa pūrvavatbrahmadaṇḍīyamūlaṃ tu madhunā saha bhakṣayet

sanskrit: eṣu sthāneṣu ye daṣṭāste na jīvanti mānavāgrīvācibukakaṇṭheṣu karamadhye ca tālukemarmasandhiṣu sarvatra sarpadaṣṭo na jīvatiaśubhāstithayaḥ proktāssarpadaṣṭo na jīvatipūrvāstisrastathā citrāśleṣābheṣu na jīvatikālavelā vāravelā sarpadaṣṭo na jīvativimuñcati viṣaṃ ghoraṃ tenāyaṃ kālasaṃjñakaḥcakrākṛtiśca vā daṃśaḥ pakvajambūphalākṛtiḥsravenmūtrapurīṣaṃ vā hṛcchūlaṃ chardidāhakṛtviyogo devadaṣṭākhyaṃ taṃ vidyātkālapāśagamromāñcā na bhavedyasya taṃ vidyātkālapāśagamtatkṣaṇāttīvradāhaśca so'pi kālena bhakṣitaḥsomaṃ sūryaṃ yadā dīptaṃ na paśyati ca tārakamna paśyedvīkṣyamāṇo'pi kāladaṣṭo na saṃśayaḥsarpadaṃśe viṣaṃ nāsti kāladaṣṭo na jīvatirasadivyauṣadhīnāṃ tu prabhāvātkālajidbhavetdevadālyā drarvermathyaṃ dinaṃ niṣkaṃ tu bhakṣayetnaramūtraṃ pibeccānu kāladaṣṭopi jīvativāriṇā peṣitaṃ nasyaṃ kāladaṣṭopi jīvatisamasadanagataḥ syādānayettatkṣaṇenavṛścikā vīraṇāmūlaṃ lepātsarvaviṣāpahamsaindhavaṃ vā nṛmūtreṇa pratyekaṃ viṣanāśanamtaṇḍulodaka pānena pratyekaṃ viṣanāśanamgaukṣīrai rajanī kuṣṭhaṃ kvāthapānaṃ viṣāpahamtoyairvā taṇḍulīmūlaṃ pratyekaṃ viṣajidbhavet

sanskrit: carācaraviṣaghnaṃ tanmṛtasañjīvanaṃ pibetchāyāśuṣkavaṭī mūtraiḥ pānairlepairviṣāpahāharidrāpānamātreṇa viṣaṃ hanti carācaramyadi sarpaviṣārtānāṃ sarvasthānagataṃ viṣamharidrākuṣṭhamadhvājyaṃ bhuktaṃ sarvaviṣāpahampuṣyoddhṛtaṃ tasya mūlaṃ nasyena viṣanāśanamarkamūlena saṃlipya daṃśaṃ viṣaharaṃ mahatsarpa haritavarṇaṃ ca pucchāgre pāṭayecchiraḥmṛtasañjīvanaṃ hyetatkāladaṣṭopi jīvatitatkṣaṇādvamayedyastu viṣayogādvimuñcatitatkṣaṇād vamate śīghraṃ viṣayogādvimucyateśuklavṛkṣe tu śuklāntāṃ caturviṃśatibhiḥ sahapītvā tairnirviṣo daṣṭaḥ kathitaṃ haramekhaleguṭikālepanāddhanti viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamamguṭikā lepamātreṇa viṣaṃ hanti mahādbhutampiṣṭvā pibetsasarpiṣkaṃ viṣaṃ hanti na saṃśayaḥtālakaṃ sarṣapāḥ śvetā gavāṃ pittena loḍayettakṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya nirviṣī kurute kṣaṇātjalena guṭikāṃ nasyetkāladaṣṭo'pi jīvatigṛhadhūmena vā lepaḥ śiraḥkaṇṭhaviṣaṃ haretlepe pāne na sandeho nānāviṣavināśanamnasye vāsukidaṣṭasya nirviṣaṃ śītavāriṇālepanāñjana nasyena kāladaṣṭo'pi jīvatijambīrasya rasaiḥ pītvā raudrīviṣanivāraṇampītvā raudrīviṣaṃ hanti lepādguñjābalāṃ nataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: api vāsukinā daṣṭāḥ pibeddadhighṛtānvitamtakṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya nirviṣaṃ kurute dhruvamanena mantreṇoktayogānabhimantrayetpayasā raktagaṃ hanti māṃsagaṃ kuṣṭhacūrṇataḥśukragaṃ hanti lauhityaṃ tasmāddeyāparājitātatsarvairviṣakīṭādyairbhakṣyamāṇo na bādhyatelepaḥ karṇamalenāpi nṛmūtraiḥ secanena vāvarāhakarṇikāmūlaṃ haste baddhaṃ viṣāpahambhāvitaṃ sarpadaṣṭānāṃ pāne nasye'ñjane hitammūlāni vāriṇā piṣṭvā kāladaṣṭaharaṃ pibetsthāvaraṃ tu viṣaṃ dadyāddaṣṭo daṣṭena hanyatetuṇḍāgre piśitaṃ bhuktvā bahuśastena daṃśitaḥaśakyamagadairanyairviṣeṇaiva cikitsayetviṣeṇa lepayeddaṃśaṃ kāladaṣṭo'pi jīvatidaṃśe deśaṃ mṛtasyāpi daṣṭo jīvati tatkṣaṇātmukto'sau mriyate sarpaḥ svayaṃ nirviṣatāṃ vrajetyadvā tadvā phalaṃ dantaissarpabhāvena bhakṣayetsarpabhāve na sandeho na tasya kramate viṣamatyantaviṣayogārttaṃ jalamadhye vinikṣipetsthāne tatra sa eva yāti niyataṃ cakrī yamasyācirātbhramādvā daśate sarpastadā sarpo vinaśyatipuṣye śvetārkamūlaṃ tu śvetavarṣāmbumūlakamsarpabhītivināśārthaṃ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ naraiḥatiroṣānvitastasya takṣakaḥ kiṃ kariṣyatisarpavṛścikamūṣāṇāṃ mukhastambhaḥ prajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrajapātsiddhiḥ | anena mantreṇa haste bandhayetdṛṣṭvā gacchanti te dūraṃ sarpādyā viṣakīṭakāḥarkakṣīrayutaṃ hanti dhūpo vṛścikajaṃ viṣamdhūpau nihantyāśu viṣaṃ samastaṃ caturvidhaṃ vṛścika vṛścikasarpajātamdaṃśaṃ ca dhūpayecchīghraṃ sarvadhūpeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥarkadhattūramūlaṃ vā jalapāne viṣāpahammajjāṃ toyaḥ pralepo'yaṃ hanti vṛścikajaṃ viṣamtilamātraṃ viṣaṃ khādellepādvā nāśayedviṣambījapūrakamūlasya lepādvāpi harītakītattaptaṃ vahninā spṛṣṭaṃ daṃśasthāne viṣaṃ haretvṛścikasya viṣaṃ hanti pratyekaṃ naiva saṃśayaḥuttarābhimukhenaiva hrūṃ (krūṃ) mantroccāraṇātspṛśetsaptadhā mārjanenaiva viṣaṃ vṛścikajaṃ haretravivāre samuddhṛtya dvābhyāṃ vṛścikadaṃśanamkarpāsamūlaṃ carvitvā viṣajitkarṇaphūtkṛtemukhasthaṃ phūtkṛtaṃ karṇe viṣaṃ vṛścikajaṃ haretpralepādavṛścikaviṣaharaṇaṃ cābhimaṃtritātdhūpaṃ dattvā guggulena arkapatraṃ ca veṣṭayetpānaṃ mūṣika daṣṭānāṃ dattaṃ tīvraṃ viṣaṃ haretlepādākhuviṣaṃ hanti pibedvā kṣīrapācitāmviṣaṃ mūṣikadaṣṭānāṃ śamamāpnoti tatkṣaṇātpurāṇājyena saptāhaṃ lihedākhuviṣaṃ harettallepena varārohe naśyetkukkurajaṃ viṣamśvānadaṣṭaviṣaṃ hanti lepātkukkuṭaviṣṭhayāsukhoṣṇaṃ bandhayetpiṇḍaṃ tridinānte sukhāvaham

sanskrit: tryūṣamājyaṃ meghanādo bhekamatsyaviṣāpahamśṛṅgīmatsyaviṣaṃ svedāghṛtacikkāṃ sapiṇḍitāmpibenmadhusitāyuktaṃ gṛhagodhāviṣaṃ haretrudhiraṃ srāvayeddaṃśāddahellohaśalākayākimatra bahunoktena tatkṣaṇādviṣanāśanamdhattūrapatratoyena cūrṇaṃ trikaṭusambhavamkarañjatailalepena jvālāṃ vyāghranakhādbhavāmlepo hi sarvajantūnāṃ nakhatuṇḍaviṣaṃ haretuṣṇodakena lepaḥ syānnakhatuṇḍaviṣāpahaḥtathā dāruharidrāyā lepo dantaviṣāpahaḥtandulodakapānena kīṭakotthaṃ viṣaṃ haretmūlaṃ bījaṃ kāñjikena lepaḥ kīṭaviṣāpahaḥudvarttanātpralepādvā sarvakīṭavikārajiteraṇḍatailalepo vā sarvakīṭaviṣāpahaḥeṣāṃ lepo nihantyāśu viṣaṃ lūtādisambhavamlepanāñjananasyaistu pānādvā niṣkamātrataḥdussahaṃ yadviṣaṃ cāśu visphoṭaṃ ca vināśayetsarpamaṣakamārjjāravṛścikādiviṣaṃ haretvajrī jaipālakaḥ kṛṣṇakuṣṭhaṃ guñjā tathaiva casasindhuṃ kāñjikaṃ pītvā samastopaviṣaṃ haretnimbapatraṃ ghṛtaṃ hanti ghṛtena madhupānataḥmiśritaṃ nakhakeśādyairlohādyaiścūrṇasañcayamraktasrāvo jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ pītacakṣuśca lakṣayettrayāṇāṃ gandhakaṃ tulyaṃ mardyaṃ kanyādravairdinamvahnimūlayutaṃ kṣīraṃ manuṣyagaranāśanam

sanskrit: pītvā cogragaraṃ hanyānnānākṛtrimayogajamśaṭhīpuṣkaramūlasya pānaṃ madyaviṣāpahamkṣīraṃ mudgayutaṃ pathyaṃ śālyannaṃ paramaṃ hitamghṛtaśeṣaṃ pacetsarvaṃ pibetsarvaṃgarāpahamnaramūtreścaiva piṣṭāṃ pibetsarvagarāpahamcūrṇāddvidhā sitā yojyā bhuktvā garaharaṃ bhavettandulīmūlasaṃyuktaṃ karṣaṃ garaharaṃ lihetsamāṃśena tu madhvājyamevaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣammarīcatumbikāmūlaṃ yogajaṃ viṣameva tatdevadālīnṛmūtrairvā sarpākṣī cendravāruṇīmadhvājyaṃ kākajaṅghāyā dravaiḥ piṣṭvā viṣaṃ haretgirikarṇī nāgapuṣpī muṇḍīpānādviṣaṃ haretnavanītaṃ tilaṃ piṣṭvā tallepena tu taṃ jayettatsañjātavikārāṃśca nāśayatyeva niścitamiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne viṣanivāraṇaṃ nāma caturdaśopadeśaḥbhaginīmātṛputrīstrīrūpaṃ tulyaṃ yathopsitamupaviśyājinādau ca prātaḥ snātvā na kaṃ spṛśetyāvatpratyakṣatāṃ yānti yakṣiṇyo vāñchitapradāḥdaśāṃśaṃ gugguluṃ sājyaṃ hutvā tuṣyati yakṣiṇīlakṣatrayaṃ tataḥ siddhā devī ca vaṭayakṣiṇīdivyāñjanaṃ tu sā tuṣṭā sādhakāya prayacchatitatassaptābhimantreṇa kāñjikaiḥ kṣālayenmukhamsiddhāni sarvakāryāṇi nānyathā śaṅkaro'bravītsarvālaṅkāriṇīṃ divyāṃ samālikhyārcayettataḥtrisaṃdhyaṃ saptarātraṃ tu tato rātriṣu nirjapet

sanskrit: pañcaviṃśatidīnārān pratyahaṃ toṣitā satīdhūpaṃ dattvā japenmantraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ trisahasrakamdattvārghyaṃ praṇamenmantrī brūte sātvaṃ kimicchatitato dadāti sā tuṣṭā vittāyuścirajīvitampañcāśanmānuṣāṇāṃ ca dadāti bhojanaṃ sadāpratipattithimārabhya pūjāṃ kṛtvā japettataḥdīnārāṇāṃ sahasraikaṃ dadāti paritoṣitāśatapuṣpodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saghṛtairhomamācaretprasannā yacchati tataḥ sarvasiddhirbhaviṣyatiratnatrayaṃ tathā bhojyaṃ saumyo mantrī sukhī bhavetdhārayejjapamālāṃ ca tādṛśīṃ tu śmaśānataḥtato mahābhayā yakṣī prayacchati rasāyanamvalīpalitanirmuktaściraṃjīvī bhavennaraḥpratipatpūrvapūrṇāntaṃ navalakṣamidaṃ japetamṛtaṃ candrikādattaṃ pītvā jīvo'maro bhavetmṛtakotthāpanaṃ kuryyātpratimāṃ cālayettathātrailokye yādṛśī vārtā tādṛśaṃ kathayetphalamtadvalirdīyate tasyai vaṭādho māsamekataḥtatraiva sā varaṃ datte nityaṃ sānnidhyakārakampratimāḥ parvatānsarvāścālayatyeva tatkṣaṇātnīrandhre bhūrjapatre ca māyābījaṃ dale daleatītānāgataṃ sarvaṃ svapne vadati devatāmūrdhni baddhvā tathāsuptaṃ vadatyeva śubhāśubhambandhūkakusumaiḥ paścānmadhvājyaiḥ kṣīramiśritaiḥtataḥ siddhā bhaveddevī vicitrā vāñchitapradā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcopacāranaivedyairdevadevīṃ prapūjayetarddharātre gate devī vārttāṃ vakti śubhāśubhāmpadmapatraiḥ kṛto homo ghṛtopetairdaśāṃśataḥsukhena taṃ ca gṛhṇāti na vighnaiḥ paribhūyatemadhunājyaiḥ kṛte home kālakarṇī prasīdatisatataṃ tāṃ smarenmaṃtrī vividhaiśvaryakāriṇīmsakṣīrairmālatīpuṣpairghṛtahomo daṃśāṃśataḥtayā mukhasthayā'dṛśyaścirasthāyī bhavennaraḥlakṣamāvarttayenmantraṃ homaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśataḥrasaṃ rasāyanaṃ divyaṃ vidhānaṃ ca prayacchatitataḥ siddhā bhaveddevī śobhanā bhogadāyinīkṛtvā devīṃ samabhyarcya dhūpaṃ dattvā sahasrakamrātrau pūjāṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā japenmatraṃ niśārddhakedadāti mantriṇemantraṃ divyayogaṃ ca niścitamkṛtvā hastapramāṇena pūjayettatra padminīmmāsamekaṃ tataḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā rātrau punarjjapetnidhānaṃ divyayogaṃ ca tasmānmantrī sukhī bhavetiti śrīnityanāthaviracite kāmaratne yakṣiṇīsādhanaṃ nāma pañcadaśopadeśaḥaghoreṇaiva mantreṇa rasarājasya pūjanamsarvataḥ sarvasarvebhyo namaste'stu rudrarūpebhyaḥpātayetpātanāyantre samyakśuddho bhavedrasaḥpāribhadrarasaiḥ peṣyaṃ hiṃgulaṃ yāmamātrakamtaṃ sūtaṃ yojayedyoge saptakañcukavarjitamjambīrotthadravairyāmaṃ pātyaṃ pātālayantrakeityevaṃ śuddhayaḥ khyātāstāsāmekāṃ tu kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kramādagnirvidadhyāttatpātālaṃ yantramucyateajāśakṛttuṣāgniṃ tu bhūgarte tritayaṃ kṣipetkhalvaṃ lohamayaṃ śastaṃ pāṣāṇoṣṇamathāvi vābrahmahā sudurācāro mantradrohī maheśvaritrikaṭuṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca mātuluṅgaṃ rasāplutamsāranāle tu mṛdbhāṇḍe grāsārthī jāyate dhruvamdinaikaṃ dhārayedgharme mṛtpātre vā mṛto bhavetcatuṣṣaṣṭyādi tulyāṃśaṃ deyaṃ jīrṇañca cālayetpunarviṃśatimaṃ grāhyaṃ dviraṣṭadvādaśaṃ kramātpratigrāse taptakhalve dinamamlena mardayettadyantraṃ dhārayedgharme dinaṃ syājjārito rasaḥdṛḍhavastre bahirbaddhvā mṛdghaṭe svedayedbudhaḥtamuddhataṃ rasaṃ devi khalve saṃśodhayetkṣaṇātkrameṇānena deveśi tribhirgrāsaiḥ prajīryatepratigrāse taptakhalve yathāśaktyā ca jārayettaṃ hi sarvarasopetaṃ piṣṭvā khalve vimardayetpuṭayedbhūdhare yantre dinānte tatsamuddharetdinaikaṃ tatpacedyantre kacchapākhye na saṃśayaḥcakramūṣānvite dhmāte bhasma sūtaṃ bhavenmalamṭaṅkaṇaṃ madhu lākṣā ca kurṇāguñjāyuto rasaḥdhmāto bhasmatvamāpnoti śuddhaḥ sphaṭikasannibhaḥmardayenmārkavadrāvairdinamekaṃ nirantaramityevaṃ jārite sūte māraṇaṃ parikīrtitamsūtakaṃ ghanasattvaṃ ca mardayetkaṃguṇīdravaiḥgarbhayaṃtragataṃ pacyāt tridinaṃ hi tuṣāgninā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūtaṃ svarṇaṃ vyoma śaṅkhaṃ samaṃ rambhādravairdinamsarvakairmūlikādrāvādanamekaṃ tu mardayetbrahmadaṇḍī meghanādo citrakaṃ kaṭutumbikākandorambhā ca nirguṇḍī lajjā jātī jayantikāguḍūcī lāṅgalī nīrakaṇā kālī mahoragāuktasthāne prayoktavyā rasarājasya siddhayetryaṅgulīmadhyavitāre vartulaṃ kārayenmukhamsuślakṣṇaṃ peṣayitvā tu toyaṃ dattvā punaḥ punaḥandhayitvā puṭaṃ deyaṃ garbhayantramidaṃ bhavetsaptavāraṃ prayatnena śuddhimāyāti niścitammasṛṇaḥ kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ śreṣṭho gandhaka ucyatetatpūrvaṃ cūrṇitaṃ gandhaṃ kṣiptvā tasyopari nyasetdugdhabhāṇḍaṃ nyasya bhūmau deyamūrdhvapuṭaṃ laghugandhaṃ ghṛte vipaktavyaṃ yāvattailanibhaṃ bhavetevaṃ gandhakaśuddhiḥ syāttatto yogeṣu yojayetpinākaṃ darduraṃ nāgaṃ vajraṃ ceti caturvidhammuñcatyagnau ca nikṣiptaḥ pināko dalasañcayamdarduro'gnau vinikṣiptaḥ kurute darduradhvanimnāgaścāgnisthitaḥ sadyaḥ phūtkāraṃ ca vimuñcativajrābhrakaṃ tu vahnau ca na kiñcidvikriyāṃ vrajetdhamedvajrābhrakaṃ vahnau yāvadagninibhaṃ bhavetbhāvayedaṣṭayāmaṃ ca jāyate doṣavarjitamtridinaṃ sthāpayetpātre tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ papeṣayetvastreṇa baddhvā sāranāle bhāṇḍamadhye vimardayetadoṣābhragataṃ śuddhaṃ śuṣkaṃ dhānyābhrakaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00239 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dinamardhapuṭe pacyātsaptadhainaṃ mṛtaṃ bhavetdhānyābhrakasya bhāgaikaṃ dvau bhāgau ṭaṅkaṇasya tusvabhāvaśītalaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvayogeṣu yojayettriphalotthakaṣāyasya palānyādāya ṣoḍaśaekīkṛtvā lohapātre pācayenmṛduvahninādravairjīrṇaṃ samādāya sarvayogeṣu yojayetbhāvyaṃ rasastadanu mūlarase kadalyā vedāṃśaṭaṅkaṇayutaṃ śapharīsametambhastrīdvayena ca tato vamate hi sattvaṃ pāṣāṇadhātugatamātramasaṃśayostijayantībhṛṅgarājotthaṃ raktāgastirasaiḥ śilāmkṣālayedāranālena sarvayogeṣu yojayetdolāyantreṇa yāmaikaṃ tataḥ kūṣmāṇḍaje raseevaṃ yantre caturyāmaṃ pācyaṃ śuddhyati tālakampuṭaṃ dadhnā puṭaṃ kṣaudre deyaṃ tutthaṃ viśuddhayegharme śuddhyati kāśīśaṃ dinaṃ jambīrabhāvitamprakṣālyaṃ grāhayettāvacchuddhimāyāti nānyathāsabhasmalavaṇairhema śodhayetpuṭapākataḥityetā mṛttikāḥ pañca jambīrairāranālakaiḥnāgena ṭaṅkaṇenaiva dhūme śuddhyati raupyakamtena liptaṃ tāmrapatraṃ taptaṃ taptaṃ niṣecayetkhadirāranālatakrāntanirguṇḍī na viśuddhayeiti tīkṣṇaṃ tridhā taṃ ca śodhayedyogasiddhayetutthaṭaṅkaṇakācairvā dhāmitaṃ śuddhamṛcchatiprakṣālayedāranālaiḥ śoṣyaṃ śuddhimavāpnuyātadhorddhaṃ gandhakaṃ dattvā sarvatulyaṃ nirudhya canirutthaṃ jāyate bhasma gandhaṃ deyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ

sanskrit: jambīrīnarapiṣṭena pañcaviṃśadvanopalaiḥmriyate nātra sandehastattatkarmaṇi yojayetkaṇṭavedhīkṛtaṃ patramandhayitvā puṭe pacetjambīrairāranālairvā piṣṭvā baddhvā puṭe pacetmātuluṅgadravaiḥ piṣṭvā puṭamekaṃ pradāpayetsitaśarkarayāpyaikaṃ puṭaṃ deyaṃ mṛtaṃ bhavetśuṣkaṃ gajapuṭe pācyaṃ nirdoṣaṃ sarvarogahṛtādau mantrastathā karma kartavyaṃ mantra ucyategharme dhārya dinaṃ kāṃsye dravaṃ deyaṃ punaḥ punaḥevamaṣṭadinaṃ kuryāttrividhaṃ mriyate tu yaḥtadā lohaṃ mṛtaṃ vidyādanyathā sādhayetpunaḥgandhakaṃ tulyakaṃ lohaṃ tulyaṃ khalve vimardayetityevaṃ sarvalohānāṃ kartavyaṃ syānnirutthanamjīrṇe ghṛte samādāya yogavāheṣu yojayetathavā kukkuṭaṃ vīraṃ kṛtvā mandiramāśritammuñcettu tāmravatsattvametad bhūnāgasattvakammūlikā navakṣāraśca jñeyaṃ lavaṇapañcakamtrikṣāraṣṭaṅkaṇakṣāro yavakṣāraśca svarjikāmūlakārdrakacitrāśca sarvamantaḥ puṭepacetgrāhyaṃ kṣārāvaśeṣaṃ tu vṛkṣakṣāramidaṃ smṛtamvastraṃ pūtaṃ jalaṃ grāhyaṃ gandhakaṃ tena bhāvayetkanyāhayāridhattūradravairbhāvyaṃ tu gandhakambījo'yaṃ jāraṇe śreṣṭho bījānāṃ drāvaṇe hitaḥcāṅgerī caṇaśukraśca amlavargaḥ prakīrtitaḥbhāgaṃ rasaṃ samādāyaṃ vajramūṣā viracya te
